scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you are carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back after -
- you put some items into Kafra Storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！ -
- 您目前攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請先將部分物品存入卡普拉倉庫 -
- 再回來。 -

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
My back is killing me
after stooping over to
pick up stones all day long...
The pain... It's unbearable!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
我彎腰撿了一整天的石頭...
現在腰疼得要命！簡直受不了！

scripts.text: Bend with your knees, yo.
scripts.translation: 你該用膝蓋彎下去啊

scripts.text: Gosh, how bad is it?
scripts.translation: 天哪，疼得有多厲害？

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Whippersnapper!
I didn't ask you for
your advice! Don't
patronize an old man!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
臭小鬼！
我沒讓你給我出主意！
別用那種居高臨下的語氣對待一個老人！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Oh, it hurts so much, it's
almost crippling. But I don't
have any choice. I need to
get enough stops to fill
this gap if I want to get
paid. Arrrrgh, damn it!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
哎喲，疼得厲害，幾乎要癱瘓了。可我別無選擇。
我得撿夠石頭填上這個缺口，才能拿到工錢。啊...該死！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
If I don't get enough
money to pay for my
granddaughter's medicine,
I won't be able to buy any
medicine for my granddaughter!
And that will be horrible! Ag!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
如果我賺不到足夠的錢給孫女買藥，她就沒藥吃了！
那可就糟了！啊！

scripts.text: Can I help?
scripts.translation: 我能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
I appreciate your kindness,
stranger, but no. I have
to do this on my own.
A man must have his pride....
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
謝謝你的好意，陌生人，不過不用了。
我必須靠自己完成這件事。男人得有骨氣...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Argh! My back...!
This was totally
unforeseeable!
Please! Please,
for the love of Freya,
please help me!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
啊！
我的腰...！
這完全沒預料到！
求求你！
求求你，看在芙蕾雅的面子上，幫幫我吧！

scripts.text: I will help you.
scripts.translation: 我會幫您的

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thank you!
Thanks so much!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
謝謝！
太感謝了！

scripts.text: What do you want me to do?
scripts.translation: 你想讓我做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Ow-ow-ow! Oh... Okay...
You see those all dark
stones stuck in the ground?
Those are what I need to
pick up. Now don't go
lifting rocks just yet...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
哎喲哎喲！哦...好吧...看到那些嵌在地上的黑色石頭了嗎？
那些就是我要撿的。先別急著搬石頭...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
I asked some other old
man in town, Absar, to
make me something to help
with my back. He was going
to help me if I gave hi--
ARGH! My back! It hurts!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
我請鎮上另一位老人阿布薩爾幫我做點東西，好緩解腰痛。
他說只要我給他...啊！我的腰！好痛！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
It hurts so bad! But it's
especially painful right
when I'm about to finish
sentences in which I intend to
tell you important informat--
ARRRGH! Find Absar! Quickly!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
疼死了！尤其是我正要說出重要事情的時候...啊啊啊！
快去找阿布薩爾！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Wait, wait...
Maybe I can answer
a few of your questions
before my body is wracked
with throbbing pain. Let's...
Let's at least give it a try.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
等等...也許我還能在劇痛發作前回答你幾個問題。
我們...至少試試看吧。

scripts.text: What's with these stones?
scripts.translation: 這些石頭是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: Where's the old man?
scripts.translation: 那個老人在哪裡？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Well, we use these dark
stones because they're
pretty and easy to process.
They're sort of a specialty
of this town. I get paid to
harvest these handy rocks.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
我們用這些黑石頭，是因為它們漂亮又容易加工。
它們算是鎮上的特產。我靠採集這些石頭賺錢。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
We can sell these to tourists,
and we even have a factory
that uses these stones.
Still, it's not like the
townspeople are getting
rich off these stones.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
我們可以把它們賣給遊客，甚至有個工廠也用這些石頭。
不過，鎮上的人並沒有靠這些石頭髮財。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
All of us are still
barely making a living...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
我們大家都還勉強維持生計...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Absar? He's inside
the Tool Shop. You
can't miss him... Just
look for the man with
the crazy eyes!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
阿布薩爾？他在工具店裡。
你肯定找得到...就找那個眼神很瘋狂的人！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thanks for your help.
If you can't find Absar
in the Tool Shop, then
you might want to stop
by the Tavern. A-auuugh!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
謝謝你的幫忙。如果你在工具店找不到阿布薩爾，可以去酒館看看。啊...啊！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thanks for your help.
If you can't find Absar
in the Tool Shop, then
you might want to stop
by the Tavern. A-auuugh!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
謝謝你的幫忙。
如果在工具店找不到阿布薩爾，也許可以去酒館看看。
啊...啊...啊！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Geez, Absar sure can
be fussy. Still, do your
best to get what he wants.
He won't help me otherwise!
Other than that, he's not
really that bad a guy...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
天哪，阿布薩爾還真是挑剔。
不過，還是儘量滿足他的要求吧。
不然他就不肯幫我了！
除此之外，他其實也不是什麼壞人...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Oh good, you're back!
Did you bring what
Absar made for me?
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
哦，你回來了！
你帶阿布薩爾給我做的東西了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, here...
scripts.translation: 是的，給你

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
So this is what he
was talking about?
How does it... Ah!
Here we go! If I pull
the handle, that end of
the stick will pick stuff up!
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
原來這就是他說的東西？怎麼用呢...啊！我懂了！
拉動手柄，棍子另一端就能把東西撿起來！

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
This is great! I won't
have to bend over to pick
up stones anymore! Heh,
he must be awfully proud
of this useful invention~
I can imagine him strutting.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
太棒了！
我再也不用彎腰撿石頭了！
呵呵，他一定對這個實用的發明很自豪吧~我都能想像到他得意洋洋的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Um, did he have anything
to say after he gave this
to you? I'm just curious.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
那個，他給你這個的時候，有沒有說什麼話？
我只是有點好奇。

scripts.text: This message...
scripts.translation: 這封信

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Oh... I thought he
would forget all about
that. Well, it's a relief
to know that now. That's
really very nice of him.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
哦...我還以為他全忘了呢。
現在知道了，真是讓人放心。
他真的很貼心。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
I hate to ask you...
But would you mind
helping me out one
more time?
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
真不好意思要麻煩你...但你能不能再幫我一次？

scripts.text: Huh? What is it?
scripts.translation: 嗯？怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Don't worry, it's not
too hard. Would you just
deliver the stones I gathered
to the factory in town? It's
near the airport or airship or
something. It won't take long.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
別擔心，不難。你能把我採的石頭送到鎮上的工廠嗎？
就在機場或飛空艇附近。不會花太久。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thanks again for your help!
What did Absar call this
thing again? A Tactile...
Extendable... Damn it...
Why's the name so long?
Anyway, it's usefull~
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
再次感謝你幫忙！阿布薩爾管這個叫什麼來著？觸覺...伸縮...該死，名字怎麼這麼長？總之，它很好用~

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Oh, you're back!
I really appreciate all
of your help. I don't have
much, and I know you weren't
expecting a reward, but I'd
like to give you something.
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
哦，你回來了！
非常感謝你的幫助。
我沒什麼錢，我知道你也沒指望什麼報酬，但我還是想送你點東西。

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Ah, here we are. I found
these while harvesting stones
I was told that adventurers
find these useful. Anyway,
I hope you like these rocks...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
啊，找到了。
這是我採石頭時撿到的。
聽說冒險者覺得這些很有用。
總之，希望你喜歡這些石頭...

scripts.text:
[Zabaroo]
Thanks to you and Absar,
my poor back hasn't been
bothering me at all lately.
I should be taking better
care of myself at my age...
scripts.translation:
[扎巴魯]
多虧了你和阿布薩爾，我最近腰都不疼了。
像我這個年紀，本該更注意保養身體的...

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Bwahahaha!
Once... Once this is completed, I'll...
Mwahahahahahahahah!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
哇嗚哈哈哈ha！
只要...只要完成這個，我就...
哇哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
I'm so close to
completion. Now, if
I just turn this here...
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
馬上就要完成了。
現在，只要轉動這裡...

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Absar]
What?! Who dares
disturb me?! N-no!
Look! Look what you did!
You made me screw up!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
什麼？！誰敢打擾我？！不...不！
看！看看你幹了什麼！
你讓我搞砸了！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Oh, no...
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Absar]
How...?!
No! I failed again!
D-DAAAAAAAAAAAMN IIIII--
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
怎...怎麼會？！
不！我又失敗了！
該...該死啊——

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Huh? What are you...
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
嗯？你是...？
你想幹什麼？

scripts.text: Oh, I-I'm...
scripts.translation: 啊，我...我

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Spit it out. Tell me
what you want, not your
name. Hurry, can't you
see that I'm busy?
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
有話快說。
告訴我你想要什麼，別報名字。
快點，沒看到我正忙著嗎？

scripts.text: I... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我...我很抱歉

scripts.text: I'm here for Mr. Zabaroo...
scripts.translation: 我是來找扎巴魯先生的

scripts.text:
[Absar]
If only you didn't
interrupt me! Then
I'd already have...
Ugh! Back to work!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
要不是你打斷我！
我早就...唉！
繼續幹活！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Zabaroo? What does...
Oh. Never mind. I think
I remember what he asked
me to make him. So did
you bring all the materials?
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
扎巴魯？
他讓我做什...哦。
算了。
我想起來了，他讓我給他做的那個東西。
那麼，你把材料都帶齊了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: What materials...?
scripts.translation: 什麼材料...？

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Great, we can get
started and m--
Liar. You don't even know
what you're supposed to
bring me, do you?!
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
很好，我們可以開始做...
騙子。你根本不知道該給我帶什麼，對吧？！滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Of course. I didn't tell him
what materials I needed
anyway. Heh heh! Now, this
is what I need you to bring.
Listen up, okay? And hurry.
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
當然。
反正我也沒告訴他我需要什麼材料。
嘿嘿!！
好了，這就是你需要帶回來的東西。
聽好了，好嗎？
快點。

scripts.text:
[Absar]
^4D4DFF5 Maneater Roots^000000,
^4D4DFF2 Glacial Hearts^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Steel^000000. If you don't
come back soon, then
I won't help you. I've got
projects I'm working on!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
^4D4DFF5個食人樹根^000000、^4D4DFF2個冰塊心臟^000000，還有^4D4DFF5個鋼鐵^000000。
你要是不快點回來，我就不幫你了。我手頭還有別的專案！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Good, you finally
brought everthing.
I was just about to
give up on you, so
consider yourself lucky!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
很好，你終於把東西都帶來了。
我差點就要放棄你了，算你運氣好！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Give me a second.
You won't have to
wait long to see
my great invention!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
給我一點時間。
你不用等太久，就能看到我的偉大發明瞭！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
What the hell?
Hurry and bring
^4D4DFF5 Maneater Roots^000000,
^4D4DFF2 Glacial Hearts^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Steel^000000! Do you think
I'm doing this for fun?!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
搞什麼鬼？
快點把^4D4DFF5個噬人樹根^000000、^4D4DFF2個冰塊心臟^000000，還有^4D4DFF5個鋼鐵^000000帶回來！
你以為我是在開玩笑嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Here you are...
Well, I don't know
if you appreciate
inventions, but this
is a Tactile Extendable
Clamp-Release Mechanism!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
給你...不知道你能不能欣賞發明，不過這是一臺“觸覺式伸縮夾持釋放裝置”！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Tack... What...?

[Absar]
...............................
You can use this to pick
things up. From a distance.
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
...
你可以用它從遠處撿東西。

scripts.text:
[Absar]
Anyway, when you get back
to Zabaroo, let me him know
that he doesn't owe me
anything anymore. He'll...
He'll know what I mean...
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
總之，等你回到扎巴魯那裡，告訴他他不再欠我任何東西了。
他會...他會明白我的意思...

scripts.text:
[Absar]
It's a ''Tactile Extendable
Clamp-Release Mechanism.''
What's so hard to understand
about that? Hmpf! I know!
It must be the educational
system! They're to blame!
scripts.translation:
[阿布薩爾]
是“觸覺可伸縮夾持釋放裝置”。
這有什麼難懂的嗎？
哼！
我知道了！
肯定是教育制度的問題！
都是他們的錯！

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Hey, employees only beyond this point!
Geez, don't we have a sigh that says that?
We should get one...
Anyway, get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[米爾亨]
嘿，僅限員工進入！
天哪，我們難道沒有掛個牌子寫著這個嗎？
我們應該弄一個...
總之，請出去。

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Hey, employees only
beyond this point!
Geez, don't we have
a sign that says that?
We should get one...
Anyway, get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[米爾亨]
嘿，僅限員工進入！
天哪，我們難道沒有掛個牌子寫著這個嗎？
我們應該弄一個...
總之，請出去。

scripts.text: I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 對不起

scripts.text: I've brought these...
scripts.translation: 我帶來了這些

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
You're sorry,
I get it. Ummm...
Aren't you leaving?
scripts.translation:
[米爾亨]
你道歉了，我收到了。嗯...
你還不走嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Huh? What's this name
tag? Zabaroo? Wait a sec...
You're definitely not him!
scripts.translation:
[米爾亨]
咦？這是什麼名牌？扎巴魯？等一下...
你肯定不是他！

scripts.text: I'm here on his behalf.
scripts.translation: 我是替他來的

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Ah, I get it. Zabaroo's
back has really been
bothering him lately.
Okay, we can bend the
rules a bit in this situation.
scripts.translation:
[米爾亨]
啊，我明白了。
扎巴魯最近腰一直不舒服。
好吧，在這種情況下，我們可以稍微通融一下。

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Bring those rocks over
to Bahed over there.
He'll take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[米爾亨]
把那些岩石帶到那邊的巴赫德那裡。
他會處理它們的。

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
Hetarium ...
What's so special about
it? I mean, it looks just like
Iron Ore. Why the hell is
it like classified info?
scripts.translation:
[米爾亨]
赫塔裡姆...到底有什麼特別的？
看起來明明就像鐵礦石。為什麼還把它當成機密？

scripts.text:
[Mirhen]
I wish I could return to
Rekenber Headquarters...
I hate being stuck here
gathering silly rocks in
the middle of nowhere.
scripts.translation:
[米爾亨]
我真希望能回到雷根貝勒總部...我討厭被困在這裡，在荒郊野外收集愚蠢的岩石。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
lately, I've been feeling so weak...
I heard the guy before me had to quit because he also started feeling weak.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
最近，我感覺自己很虛弱...
我聽說我之前的那個傢伙因為也開始感覺虛弱而辭職了。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
It couldn't be...
It couldn't be because of this 'Hetarium'...
That's just plain crazy...
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
不會吧...
不會是因為這個“赫塔裡姆”吧...
那太瘋狂了...

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Oh, you got the rocks?
You brought them for Zabaroo?
Oh, how is he doing? I hear
he threw out his back.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
哦，你拿到岩石了？
你是替扎巴魯帶來的？
哦，他怎麼樣了？聽說他閃到腰了。

scripts.text: He still hurts.
scripts.translation: 他還是很疼

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Oh no... I'm so sorry
to hear that. I hope he
feels better soon. Anyway,
why don't you bring the
rocks over here?
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
天哪...聽到這個我很抱歉。
希望他早日康復。
總之，你為什麼不把岩石帶到這裡來呢？

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Let me confirm Zabaroo's
quota for today. Ah, and
don't worry, we pay him
for his quotas regularly.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
讓我確認一下扎巴魯今天的配額。別擔心，我們會定期按配額付給他報酬。

scripts.text: I have a question...
scripts.translation: 我有一個問題

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Hm? What'd you want
to know? I can't say that
I know everything, but
I'll try my best to tell you
what I know. I mean,
you helped Zabaroo, so...
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
嗯？
你想問什麼？
我不能說我什麼都知道，但我會盡力告訴你我所知道的。
我是說，你幫了扎巴魯，所以...

scripts.text: What's this Hetarium??
scripts.translation: 這個赫塔裡姆是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Well, it hasn't been that
long since these rocks
attracted attention outside
of town. Before all this,
the townspeople just
made carvings out of them.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
這些岩石引起鎮外關注的時間並不長。
在此之前，鎮民們只是用它們雕刻一些東西。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Then, all of a sudden,
these people from--I guess
it was Schwarzwald--came
and bought a lot of these
stones. Later, they even built
this factory to process them!
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
後來，突然有一群來自...我想是施瓦爾茲巴爾德的人，買走了很多石頭。
之後，他們甚至建了這家工廠來加工！

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Oh, they tried using machines
to harvest these stones, but
they all broke down too soon.
That's why they hired people
in Veins to collect them.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
他們試過用機器開採這些石頭，但機器很快就壞了。
所以他們僱了維因斯的人來採集。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
I'm not sure many people
know who owns this factory.
Maybe it's Rekenber? Yes,
I saw one of their corporate
airships come to town, so
I think it might be them.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
我不確定這家工廠屬於誰。也許是雷根貝勒？我見過他們的企業飛空艇來鎮上，所以我猜可能是他們。

scripts.text: How do they use Hetarium??
scripts.translation: 他們如何使用赫塔裡姆？

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
I'm not really sure. I just
happened to overhear some
of the higher ups mention
something about hearts?
Pieces of hearts? Doesn't
make any sense to me.
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
我不太清楚。
我只是偶然聽到一些高層提到什麼“心臟”？
“心臟碎片”？
對我來說毫無意義。

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
All I gathered was that
they were using the stones
to build a machine related
to those hearts. That's
all I know. Anyway, please
leave the stones over there~
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
我只知道他們正在用這些石頭建造一臺與那些心臟有關的機器。
我就知道這麼多。
總之，請把那邊的石頭放下~

scripts.text:
[Bahed]
Everyday I feel
weaker and weaker...
Could this be chronic
fatigue syndrome? Ugh...
scripts.translation:
[巴赫德]
每天我都覺得越來越虛弱...這是慢性疲勞症候群嗎？
唉...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What the heck are these rocks?
They're ordinary stones, aren't they?
They don't pay me enough here...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
這些岩石到底是什麼鬼？
它們不就是普通的石頭嗎？
這裡的工資也太低了...

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Where the heck
is it? I don't... Where...?
He's got to be around here
somewhere, I think...
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
該死，他在哪？
我不...在哪...？
他應該就在這附近吧...

scripts.text: What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Oh, it's just...
Some guy sent me on a
delivery errand, but I can't
find the recipient. He said
that I can't miss him, but
I still can't figure it out.
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
哦，原來是...有個人讓我送一封信，可我找不到收件人。他說我肯定能找到，但我還是沒搞清楚。

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
I should have asked for
the exact location. I mean,
if I don't find him, then I'll
never get paid for doing
this delivery. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
我本該問清楚具體位置的。
我是說，如果我找不到他，我就永遠拿不到這次送貨的報酬了。^333333*嘆氣*^000000

scripts.text: Sounds tough. Good luck!
scripts.translation: 聽起來很難。祝你好運！

scripts.text: Do you need any help?
scripts.translation: 需要幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Thanks. I think
I just might need it.
Where could this guy
be? If he's expecting
a delivery, he should
make himself easy to find...
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
謝謝，我想我確實需要幫忙。這傢伙會在哪兒？既然等著收信，就該讓自己好找一點才對...

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Yeah, sure, it'd be great
if you could help me. Let's
see, I need to deliver this
letter to a bard named...
It was... Ah, ^FF0000Lasda Midar^000000!
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
是啊，你能幫忙就太好了。讓我看看，我要把信送給一位吟遊詩人，名字叫...啊，^FF0000拉斯達·米達爾^000000！

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
I've looked everywhere
in town for someone that
looks like a Bard, but I'm
not having any luck. If you
find him, would you tell me?
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
我在鎮上到處找看起來像詩人的人，但一直沒找到。
如果你找到他，能告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
I still haven't
found Lasda Midar.
Would you let me know
if you find him so that
I can deliver his letter?
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
我還沒找到拉斯達·米達爾。
如果你找到他，能告訴我嗎？
這樣我就可以給他送信了。

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Lasda Midar...
Where the heck
could that guy be?
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
拉斯達·米達爾...
這傢伙到底在哪？

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Wow, did you really
find Lasda Midar?
Why couldn't I find him?
Anyway, thank you so much
for your help. I thought I was
going to fail my delivery!
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
哇，你真的找到拉斯達·米達爾了？
為什麼我找不到他？
不管怎樣，非常感謝你的幫助。
我以為我要送不到貨了！

scripts.text: He asked me to give you this.
scripts.translation: 他讓我把這個給你

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Hey, alright! Thanks
for the cash! Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
嘿嘿~，太好了！
謝謝你的錢！
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Rooney]
Nice day out, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[魯尼]
今天天氣真好，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Hello there, isn't today
such a wonderful day?
Nice weather always
inspires the poet in me,
and I can't seem to stop
singing my heart out~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
你好呀，今天真是美好的一天呢！
好天氣總能激發我的詩興，我忍不住想盡情歌唱~

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Why, what a glorious
day! I should sing a song
in praise of its wonder!
Ooooh... La la la-la~
Girls, girls, giiiirls...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
哇，多麼輝煌的一天！我應該唱首歌讚美這美妙的天氣！
噢...啦啦啦~女孩，女孩，女...女孩...

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Why, what a glorious
day! I should sing a song
in praise of its wonder!
Ooooh... La la la-la~
Girls, girls, giiiirls...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
哇，多麼輝煌的一天！
我應該唱首歌來讚美它的奇妙！
噢...啦啦啦啦~女孩，女孩，女...女孩...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Girls, girls, giiiirls...
Making my heart
beat like... Like it's
going too fast. My heart's
racing... And you're at the
finish line--Love Champion!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
女孩，女孩，女...女孩...讓我心跳得...像是要失控了。
我的心狂跳不已...而你就在終點線——愛情冠軍！

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Oh? Don't stare at me
like that, you're making
me blush. Did you need to
talk to me or something?.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
噢？
別那樣盯著我看，我會害羞的。
你是有事要找我嗎？

scripts.text: I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 對不起

scripts.text: Are you ^ff0000Lasda Midar^000000?
scripts.translation: 你是^ff0000拉斯達·米達爾^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Oh, that's alright.
...............................
Girl, I'll laugh at all your
jokes, and agree with yourv
politics~ You're hot! But
baby, you're dumb as bricks~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
噢，沒關係。
...
女孩，我會笑你講的每個笑話，也會贊同你的政見~你很迷人！不過寶貝，你笨得像塊磚~

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Oh? Oh, yes, that's me.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
噢？噢，是的，那就是我。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I'm here to deliver this to you.
scripts.translation: 我來給你送這個

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Ah! He must have finally
sent it. Would you please
give me a second? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
啊！
他終於寄來了。
請給我一點時間好嗎？
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
^3355FFLasda opened the letter
and started reading it.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF拉斯達拆開信件，開始閱讀。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Umm...
Oh, no...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
嗯...
噢，不...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Ah, I'm sorry for
making you wait.
Here, please give
this money to that
kid that was supposed
to come find me here.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
啊，抱歉讓你久等了。
請把這些錢給那個本該來這裡找我的小孩。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I'd like you to come
talk to me again later
if you have the time
See you around~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
如果你有時間，稍後再來找我聊聊吧。
回頭見~

scripts.text:
^3355FFLasda seems to be
lost in deep thought.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF拉斯達似乎陷入了沉思。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Oh good, you came back!
Thanks for delivering that
letter for me. Listen, you
mind listening to me for
a bit? I want to ask you
for your help with something.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
噢，你回來了！
謝謝你幫我送那封信。
聽著，你介意聽我說幾句嗎？
我想請你幫個忙。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
You see, the letter you
brought me was from my old
best friend. I haven't heard
from him for a while, so
I was pretty worried...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
你看，你帶給我的那封信是我最好的老朋友寄來的。
我已經很久沒收到他的訊息了，所以我很擔心...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Vitre said in his letter
that he's in jail under
false charges so he wants
me to help him out. However,
there isn't much I can do.
Do you think you can help him?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
維特雷在信裡說，他因冤屈被關在監獄裡，希望我能幫他。
但是，我無能為力。
你覺得你能幫他嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Thank you so much!
I guess the best thing
to do for now is to find
my friend in a prison in
^FF0000Morocc^000000, and see what
you can do to help him..
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
非常感謝！
我想現在最好的辦法是去^FF0000夢羅克^000000的監獄找到我的朋友，看看你能怎麼幫他。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I... I guess...
You must not be
able to help him too...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
我...我想...
你大概也幫不了他吧...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I suppose that you
must already be busy
doing something else.
Well, I understand...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
我想你肯定正忙著做別的事情。
嗯，我理解...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I still can't believe
Vitre is being held
in prison in Morocc. I mean,
what could have happened?
I hope you can help him...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
我還是無法相信維特雷會被關在夢羅克的監獄裡。
我是說，到底發生了什麼？
希望你能幫到他...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
He was arrested because
he's suspected of espionage?
That doesn't make any sense.
What could be going on?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
他是因為被懷疑從事間諜活動而被逮捕的嗎？
這完全說不通。
到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: ^ff0000Krieg^000000 told me that.
scripts.translation: ^ff0000克里格^000000告訴我的。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Krieg? Do you mean Krieg
Laje Mandi? I know him quite
well, actually. Let me write
you a letter or recommendation.
Hopefully, it'll be enough to
let you enter the prison.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
克里格？
你是說克里格·拉傑·曼迪嗎？
其實我跟他很熟。
讓我給你寫一封介紹信吧。
希望這封信能讓你進入監獄。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Hurry and go bring
my letter to Krieg.
I wonder what happened...
There must be some kind
of weird misunderstanding.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
快去把我的信交給克里格。
我想知道到底發生了什麼...
肯定有什麼奇怪的誤會。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
He really asked you
to break him out of jail?
Well, I know that's a morally
hazy area, but I hope that
you do your best to help Vitre.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
他真的讓你去把他從監獄裡救出來？
嗯，我知道這在道德上有點模糊，但我希望你能盡力幫助維特雷。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Thanks for offering
to help me out. I still
can't believe Vitre had
the gall to just break
out of prison, though...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
謝謝你願意幫我。
不過，我還是無法相信維特雷竟然敢直接從監獄裡逃出來...

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I still can't do
anything to help him,
so please do what you
can to take care of him
for me. I really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
我仍然無法為他做任何事，所以請盡力照顧他。
非常感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
Ah, you're back. I'm sure
you have a lot to ask me
right now. You deserve to
know that everything I asked
you to do was part of a plan
to confirm Vitre's guilt.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
啊，你回來了。
我想你現在有很多問題要問我。
你有權利知道，我讓你做的這一切，都是為了確認維特雷有罪而制定的計劃的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
We arrested him once
we learned that he was
an Arunafeltz spy, but we
couldn't punish him since
we lacked concrete proof.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
我們得知他是阿魯納佩茨間諜後就逮捕了他，但苦於沒有確鑿證據，無法定罪。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
That's why we allowed
him to escape: we planned
on following him to get the
proof that we needed. Our
sting was even able to round
up all of his compatriots!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
所以我們故意讓他逃走，好跟蹤他並取得證據。這次誘捕行動還一舉抓獲了他的所有同夥！

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
I'm sorry for keeping
you in the dark, but it was
essential to the plan. We
couldn't have done it without
your help. Please take this
reward with our sincere thanks.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
抱歉瞞著你，但這對於計劃至關重要。
沒有你的幫助，我們無法做到這一點。
請收下這份獎勵，以表達我們誠摯的謝意。

scripts.text:
[Lasda]
We're having too many
cases involving spies
like Vitre lately. This
might be a sign that
Arunafeltz is planning
to move against us...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯達]
最近涉及像維特雷這樣的間諜的案件太多了。
這可能意味著阿魯納佩茨正在策劃對我們採取行動...

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Only authorized
personnel can enter
this prison. You need
a permit if you want
to be able to enter.
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
只有授權人員才能進入這座監獄。
如果你想進入，需要許可證。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
What? You want to meet
the prisoner? I'm sorry,
but he's not allowed to
see anyone since he was
arrested on suspicion
of espionage.
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
什麼？
你想見那個囚犯？
抱歉，由於他被懷疑從事間諜活動而被逮捕，他目前不允許會見任何人。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Huh. You're awfully
persistent. Alright,
if you can do me a favor,
I'll let you in. Bring me
1 dish of ^FF0000Fried Monkey Tails^000000
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
嗯，你還真執著。好吧，如果你幫我一個忙，我就讓你進去。給我帶一份^FF0000油炸猴尾巴^000000。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Of course, I can only let
you inside. Whether they'll
actually let you meet the
prisoner is another matter.
So do we have a deal?
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
當然，我只能讓你進去。
他們是否真的讓你見那個囚犯，那是另一回事。
那我們成交嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Ah, that's the stuff!
Thanks for the Fried
Monkey Tails~ Alright,
go talk to ^FF0000Sir Krieg^000000 in
Morocc Castle. Get his
approval, and I'll let you in.
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
啊，就是這個味道！謝謝你的油炸猴尾巴~去夢羅克城堡找^FF0000克里格大人^000000，取得他的批准後我就讓你進去。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Bring me a plate of
^FF0000Fried Monkey Tails^000000.
Do it, or I won't help
you out. I mean, I know
you mean well, but I'm
risking my job here...
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
給我帶一份^FF0000熱炒猴尾巴^000000。
快點，不然我可幫不了你。
我知道你是好意，但我在這裡可是冒著丟掉飯碗的風險...

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
You didn't get approval
from Sir Krieg yet? You'd
better do it, or there's no
point in entering this prison.
You can't just sneak around
inside this place, you know?
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
你還沒拿到克里格大人的批准？
你最好去辦，否則進這座監獄也沒意義。
你知道的，不能隨便在這地方亂晃。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Did you really get
Sir Krieg's approval?
Alright, you may enter now.
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
你真的拿到了克里格大人的批准？
好吧，現在你可以進去了。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Do you want to enter?
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
你要進去嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Be careful when you talk
to that guy: he's a smooth
talker, and almost charmed
a lot of the guards into
letting him go free.
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
跟那個人說話時要小心：他是個能言善辯的傢伙，差點把很多衛兵都忽悠得放他走了。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Take your time.
If you're not mentally
prepared, then it's not
a good idea to talk
to the prisoner.
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
慢慢來。
如果你還沒做好心理準備，那最好不要去見那個囚犯。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Argh, I'm in trouble.
The prisoner escaped.
How could I let this...
happen?! Damn, I need to
report this to Mr. Krieg
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
啊，糟了。
囚犯逃跑了。
我怎麼會讓他...
跑掉？！該死，我得去報告克里格先生。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
What a relief! They
really set it up so that
the prisoner could escape?
Well, I thought I was going
to get fired for all that.
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
真是虛驚一場！
他們居然真的設局讓囚犯逃跑？
還好，我還以為自己要被開除了。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
I'm in charge of public
security here in Morocc.
Lately, there have been
more incidents disturbing
the public peace and
many unsettling rumors...
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
我負責夢羅克的公共安全。
最近，擾亂公共秩序的事件越來越多，還有許多令人不安的傳聞...

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Hello, adventurer.
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
你好，冒險者。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: I'd like to see a prisoner, Mr. Vitre.
scripts.translation: 我想見見囚犯，維特雷先生

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Vitre? I'm sorry, but
I can't approve of that.
I'd allow visitors for normal
prisoners, but not for people
suspected of espionage.
That's why he's in jail.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
維特雷？
抱歉，我不能批准。
普通囚犯我可以允許探視，但被懷疑從事間諜活動的人不行。
這就是他被關押的原因。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
If I knew you personally,
or if someone I trust can
vouch for you, then I'd
reconsider letting you
meet Vitre. Otherwise,
I just can't do it.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
如果我和你是舊識，或者有我信任的人為你作保，我會重新考慮讓你見維特雷。
否則，我實在無法答應。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
I can't let you meet
Vitre until I'm absolutely
sure that you're not involved
with any espionage activities.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
在我完全確定你沒有參與任何間諜活動之前，我不能讓你見維特雷。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
I can't let you meet
Vitre until I'm absolutely
sure that you're not involved
with any espionage activities.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
在我完全確定你沒有參與任何間諜活動之前，我不能讓你見維特雷。

scripts.text: Here's a letter from Lasda.
scripts.translation: 這是拉斯達的信件

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Lasda? Now there's a
man I hold in high regard.
Please let me read what
he has to say. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
拉斯達？
那可是我十分敬重的人。
請讓我看看他寫了什麼。
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Alright, I'll let you visit
Vitre. I'll send a message
to the prison ward so that
he'll let you talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
好吧，我允許你探視維特雷。我會通知監獄看守，讓他准許你和維特雷交談。

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
Hmm... This is almost too
difficult for me to handle.
What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
嗯...這對我來說幾乎太難處理了。
我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Krieg]
I understand that you were
instrumental in solving a
problem regarding public
safety. I'd just like to thank
you, and apologize for any
trouble I might have caused.
scripts.translation:
[克里格]
我瞭解到你在解決公共安全問題上發揮了重要作用。
我想向你表示感謝，併為可能給你帶來的麻煩道歉。

[維特雷]
...
...
...
該死，我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Hm? I'm Vitre Bizlita.
As you can see, I'm not in
any real position to help
you. Still, did you want
to ask me something?
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
嗯？
我是維特雷·比茲利塔。
你也看出來了，我現在這處境根本幫不上什麼忙。
不過，你有什麼想問我的嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼

scripts.text: I'm here on behalf of Mr. Lasda.
scripts.translation: 我是代表拉斯達先生來的

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Well...
It's nice to
receive visitors.
Jail can be lonely....
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
嗯...
能有人來探望，感覺還不錯。
監獄裡挺孤獨的...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Oh, good. Lasda finally
got my letter, eh? I don't
know what the hell's going
on. I mean, all I remember
is that these strange men
came and brought me here.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
哦，太好了。
拉斯達終於收到我的信了，是嗎？
我不知道到底發生了什麼事。
我只記得那些奇怪的男人把我帶到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
I... I don't think
they'll let me out
of here. I mean, they
jailed me and there's no
proof I did anything wrong.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
我...我覺得他們不會讓我出去的。
畢竟他們把我關了起來，而且沒有任何證據證明我做了什麼壞事。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
My life is in danger as
long as I'm here, so I have
to get out as soon as I can.
Luckily, I figured out that
I can open these doors if
I just had 2 things.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
只要我還在這裡，我的生命就處於危險之中，所以我必須儘快逃出去。
幸運的是，我發現只要有兩樣東西，我就能開啟這些門。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
I just need a ^FF0000Megaphone^000000
and a ^FF0000Violin^000000. Luckily, they're
pretty mundane objects, so no
one would suspect anything if
you brought them here. Um...
You will help me, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
我只需要一個^FF0000擴音器^000000和一把^FF0000小提琴^000000。它們都是普通物品，你帶來時不會有人起疑。那個...你會幫我吧？

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
I understand if you have any
doubts about my innocence.
But think about it: wouldn't
you want to see what I do
with a Megaphone and Violin?
Sounds pretty cool, huh?
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
如果你對我的清白有任何懷疑，我都能理解。
但請想想看：你難道不想看看我用擴音器和小提琴能做出什麼嗎？
聽起來很酷，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can hear someone
mumbling from the cell
next to Vitre's.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你聽到維特雷隔壁的牢房裡有人在喃喃自語。^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
I wonder how the lady
in the Dancer Job Change
place is doing by now...
scripts.translation:
[????]
不知道舞娘轉職處的那位女士現在怎麼樣了...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Didn't you bring the
Megaphone and Violin?
The longer I sit here,
the more likely it is
that they'll kill me!
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
你沒帶擴音器和小提琴嗎？
我在這裡坐得越久，他們殺我的可能性就越大！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
You brought me a
Megaphone and Violin?
Perfect! Now, step aside
Can't have you getting hurt.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
你帶了擴音器和小提琴給我？
完美！
現在，站到一邊去。
我可不想讓你受傷。

scripts.text:
^3355FFVitre drew in a deep
breath, and then smashed
the steel bars of his cell
with the Violin. Surprisingly,
the door swings open with
a very loud noise.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF維特雷深吸了一口氣，然後用小提琴砸向牢房的鋼條。
出人意料的是，門伴隨著巨大的聲響打開了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Heh! That was a little
harder than I thought,
but it looks like I'm free~
Alright, let's get a move on.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
嘿！
這比我想像的要難一點，但看起來我自由了~好了，我們趕緊走吧。

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
What?! What's this noise?!
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
什麼？！這是什麼聲音？！

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Hey! How did you
get out of your cell?!
Get back in there, NOW!
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
嘿！你是怎麼從牢房裡出來的？！
立刻回去，馬上！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
If you were me, would
you go back in your cell
just because someone's
yelling at you? Forget it~
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
如果我是你，我會因為有人衝我大喊大叫就回到牢房裡嗎？
別做夢了~

scripts.text:
^3355FFVitre raised the Megaphone
to his mouth, and drew in
another deep breath.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF維特雷把擴音器舉到嘴邊，又深吸了一口氣。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Wah!
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
哇！

scripts.text:
[Jesse]
Arg...
Oh Lord...!
M-my ears...
scripts.translation:
[傑西]
啊...
天哪...！
我...我的耳朵...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Heh! I love it when
a plan comes together~
Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
嘿！
計劃順利實施的感覺真棒~我們快離開這裡吧！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Didn't you bring
a Megaphone and
a Violin? Please
hurry, I don't have
much time left!
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
你不是帶了擴音器和小提琴嗎？
請快點，我沒多少時間了！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Heh! I love it when
a plan comes together~
Let's get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
嘿！
計劃順利實施的感覺真棒~我們快離開這裡吧！

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
This stinks. Why am
I locked up in here?
I didn't do anything
to deserve this!
scripts.translation:
[阮]
真夠噁心的。
我為什麼會被關在這裡？
我什麼都沒做，不配受這種待遇！

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
It's getting to be so
bad that I even miss the
sound of Hianna's voice.
It's freakishly loud.
You couldn't outyell her
even with a Megaphone.
scripts.translation:
[阮]
情況糟到我甚至開始想念希安娜的聲音了。
那聲音吵得嚇人。
就算用擴音器也吵不過她。

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
This stinks. Why am
I locked up in here?
I didn't do anything
to deserve this!
scripts.translation:
[阮]
真夠噁心的。
我為什麼會被關在這裡？
我什麼都沒做，不配受這種待遇！

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
It's getting to be so
bad that I even miss the
sound of Hianna's voice.
It's freakishly loud.
You couldn't outyell her
even with a Megaphone.
scripts.translation:
[阮]
情況糟到我甚至開始想念希安娜的聲音了。
那聲音吵得嚇人。
就算用擴音器也吵不過她。

scripts.text: Where I can find that Megaphone?
scripts.translation: 我在哪裡能找到那個擴音器？

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
Huh? Why would you
want to know that?
scripts.translation:
[阮]
哈？
你為什麼想知道那個？

scripts.text: I really need one!
scripts.translation: 我真的很需要！

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
Uh, you can get one from
that Dancer Job Change
place in Comodo. They're
really hard to get, though,
if not impossible. Knock
yourself out, buddy.
scripts.translation:
[阮]
呃，你可以去克魔島的舞娘轉職處找找。不過擴音器很難弄到，甚至可能根本弄不到。祝你好運，夥計。

scripts.text:
[Ruan]
Nobody knows what
will happen tomorrow.
I mean, this is a world of
miracles and tragedies.
Death, or real love...
You will never know what will happen.
scripts.translation:
[阮]
沒人知道明天會發生什麼。
我是說，這是一個充滿奇蹟和悲劇的世界。
死亡，或者真愛...
你永遠不知道會發生什麼。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Keep up the good work,
everyone! There's only
a few days left until the
big performance! Hey...
You! Can't you do it right?
Turn your waist quicker!
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
大家繼續加油！
距離大型演出只剩幾天了！
嘿...你！
能不能做對？
腰轉得再快一點！

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Hey, who are you?
We already have enough
problems with too many
pervs ogling the Dancers.
I'd prefer it if you didn't
come to watch us practice.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
嘿，你是誰？
我們已經夠頭疼了，總是有那麼多變態盯著舞娘看。
我建議你別來圍觀我們排練。

scripts.text: I want a Megaphone.
scripts.translation: 我想要一個擴音器

scripts.text: Eeek...
scripts.translation: 哎呀

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
If you really want to
watch us dance, come to
the show and buy a ticket.
Watching for free isn't
exactly supporting the arts.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
如果你真的想看我們跳舞，就來演出時買票吧。
免費觀看算不上支援藝術。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
You want a Megaphone?
Well, I'm sorry, but it's
not just something I can
lend to anybody. Then again
it's not like you can find one
anywhere else, either.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
你想要擴音器？
嗯，很抱歉，它不是隨便就能借給別人的。
不過話說回來，你在別處也找不到。

scripts.text: Please! I'll do anything!
scripts.translation: 求你了！我什麼都願意做！

scripts.text: Later.
scripts.translation: 以後再說

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Alright, then.
I'm sorry that
I can't help you.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
好吧。
很抱歉，我幫不了你。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Anything, huh?
Well, you just said
the magic word. Listen
carefully to what I want
you to do for me.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
什麼都願意做？
嗯，你可是說對了關鍵的詞。
仔細聽聽我要你為我做什麼。

scripts.text: Listen
scripts.translation: 聽

scripts.text: Reconsider
scripts.translation: 再考慮一下

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
First, I want a little
cash. Consider it a rental
fee. 500,000 zeny should be
just about enough. Then,
I want you to do me a favor.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
首先，我需要一點現金。
把它當作租賃費吧。
500,000 Zeny應該差不多夠了。
然後，我要你幫我一個忙。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
The Schwarzwald Republic
requested me to send some
Dancers for some party, but
I don't have enough guards
to protect them on their
way over there.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
施瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國請我派舞娘去參加派對，但我沒有足夠的衛兵護送她們過去。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
If you act as bodyguard
to my Dancers on the way
to the Schwarzwald Republic,
I'll lend you my Megaphone
once you come back. So...
How does that sound?
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
如果你能護送舞娘前往施瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國，回來後我就把擴音器借給你。怎麼樣？

scripts.text: Sounds good.
scripts.translation: 聽起來不錯

scripts.text: Like a ripoff.
scripts.translation: 簡直是在搶錢

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
I'm glad you agree~
Okay, the Dancers are
waiting are the entrance,
so bring them over to the
Schwarzwald Republic as
soon as you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
很高興你答應了~舞娘們正在入口等候。準備好後就護送她們前往施瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
So... I guess you
didn't need that
Megaphone as
badly as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
那麼...看來你並沒有我想像中那麼急需那個擴音器呢。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Alright, take your
time. I'm in no rush.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
好的，慢慢來。
我不著急。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
What are you still doing
here? Shouldn't you be
escorting the Dancers to
the Schwaltvalt Republic
already? Get a move on~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
你還在這裡做什麼？不應該已經護送舞娘去施瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國了嗎？快行動吧~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Thanks for all your
hard work. The Dancers
told me that you did a good
job escorting them. Now...
Do you have the money?
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
謝謝你的辛苦工作。
舞娘們告訴我你護送她們做得很好。
那麼...你有帶錢嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
What's this? Hmm...
I think you made a mistake.
This isn't enough money.
Remember, 500,000 zeny~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
這是什麼？嗯...
我想你算錯了。
錢不夠。
記住，是500,000 Zeny~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Perfect. Well, here's
your Megaphone. Thanks
for everything, and I'll see
you around, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
完美。
那麼，這是你的擴音器。
謝謝你的幫助，再見了，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
I can't have you breaking
your promises, so I won't
give you the Megaphone
until you pay me the
500,000 zeny that you
said that you would.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
我不能讓你違背承諾，所以在你支付我你答應過的500,000 Zeny之前，我不會把擴音器給你。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Thanks for escorting
my Dancers over to the
Schwarzwald Republic.
Anything I can help
you with today?
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
謝謝你護送我的舞娘去施瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國。今天還有什麼需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: I'd like another Megaphone.
scripts.translation: 我想再要一個擴音器

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Well, I guess I can let
you have another one if
you pay me 500,000 zeny.
You sure you want to pay
the money for a Megaphone?
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
嗯，如果你願意付我500,000 Zeny，我想我可以再給你一個。
你確定要花錢買一個擴音器嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
I'm sorry, but this
isn't enough money for
a Megaphone. Be sure
to bring me 500,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
很抱歉，這點錢不夠買一個擴音器。
記得帶500,000 Zeny來。

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Here you are. The fact is...
These Megaphones are
considered guild property,
so I'm not supposed to let
you have this. Don't let
anyone know I gave you this!
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
給你。
其實...這些擴音器算是公會的財產，按規定我不應該給你。
千萬別讓任何人知道我把這個給你了！

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Alright~
Take care, and
travel safely~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
好的~保重，一路順風~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Alright~
Take care, and
travel safely~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
好的~保重，一路順風~

scripts.text:
[Hianna]
Trust me, we've made
good use of the money
that you've ''donated.''
Thanks for taking good
care of my Dancers~
scripts.translation:
[希安娜]
相信我，你“捐贈”的錢我們已經好好利用起來了。
謝謝你這麼照顧我的舞娘們~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hi there~
Are you enjoying
yourself? I hope so!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
你好~玩得開心嗎？
希望你玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Ah, you must be the
bodyguard. So are you
ready to go now?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
啊，你一定是那位保鏢吧。
那麼，你準備好出發了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Alright, then.
Here we go~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
好的，那麼。
我們出發吧~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
We need to depart soon,
so please hurry. I'll be
waiting for you here~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
我們要出發了，請快點。
我會在這裡等你~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Oh, that was such a fun
performance. I can still
see the dazzling decorations
in the ballroom where we got
to dance. It was so wonderful!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哦，那場表演太有趣了。
我還能看到我們在舞廳跳舞時那些華麗的裝飾。
真是太美妙了！

scripts.translation:

我們要出發了，請快點。
我會在這裡等你~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I guess it's pretty
fun to perform on stage~
But I still need to practice
more for the next performance.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
我覺得在舞臺上表演挺有趣的~但我還需要為下一場表演多加練習。

scripts.translation:

我會在這裡等你~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I sure learned a lot from
that trip. I hope that the new
girls also gained something
from their experiences.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
那次旅行讓我學到了很多。
我希望新來的女孩們也能從經歷中有所收穫。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hi there~
Are you enjoying
yourself? I hope so!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
你好~玩得開心嗎？
希望你玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
This will be my
first performance...
I guess that's why
I have butterflies
in my stomach...
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
這將是我第一次表演...我想這就是為什麼我緊張得心裡像有蝴蝶在飛...

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I wonder which beautiful
place we'll get to perform in
next time! Ooh, I can't wait!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
不知道下次我們會去哪個美麗的地方表演！
哦，我等不及了！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hi there~
Are you enjoying
yourself? I hope so!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
你好~玩得開心嗎？
希望你玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I've performed at many
venues, but this is the
frist time I'll be dancing
in the Schwarzwald Republic.
This is also my first time on
an airship. How exciting!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
我在很多地方表演過，但這是我第一次在施瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國跳舞。這也是我第一次乘坐飛空艇。太令人興奮了！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Traveling is really
thrilling... It's almost as
fun as dancing on stage~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
旅行真的很刺激...幾乎和在舞臺上跳舞一樣有趣~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hi there~
Are you enjoying
yourself? I hope so!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
你好~玩得開心嗎？
希望你玩得愉快！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
This is the first time that
the Schwarzwald Republic
requested a performance
from us. Isn't that amazing?
I guess we earned a reputation
overseas. I'll do my best!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
這是施瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國第一次邀請我們演出。真了不起！看來我們在海外也有名氣了。我會全力以赴！

scripts.text:
[Airship Announcement]
We will be arriving
in Einbroch shortly.
Passengers to Einbroch,
please get ready to land.
scripts.translation:
[飛空艇廣播]
我們將很快抵達艾音布羅克。
前往艾音布羅克的乘客，請做好降落準備。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Oh! We're finally here!
Alright, I'll give this next
performance my all!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哦！我們終於到了！
好了，我會全力以赴完成接下來的表演！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
I've been dancing on
stage for a long time, but
I always feel so nervous
right beforehand. I wonder
why that happens to me.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
我在舞臺上跳舞很久了，但每次上臺前還是會感到緊張。
不知道為什麼會這樣。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Oh, the dinner
party isn't finished yet.
It'll be over before
you even know it~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哦，晚宴還沒結束呢。
不知不覺就會結束的~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Hooray! My first
onstage performance
was a success! Oh
I was so nervous...
But I'm so proud
of myself now!
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
萬歲！
我的第一次舞臺表演成功了！
哦我剛才好緊張...但現在我為自己感到驕傲！

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Without dance,
my life has no
meaning at all.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
沒有舞蹈，我的生命就毫無意義。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
The dinner party isn't
even finished yet, but
I'm already exhausted~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
晚宴還沒結束呢，但我已經累壞了~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
^333333*Whew*^000000 We gave a good
performance this time.
I was worried since that
airship trip really drained me.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
^333333*呼*^000000 這次的表演很成功。
之前坐飛空艇真的讓我精疲力竭，所以我很擔心。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Dancing is really
hard work, and all that
practicing wears you out,
but it's worth it once you
get up on that stage.
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
跳舞真的很辛苦，不斷的練習也會讓人疲憊，但一旦登上舞臺，一切都值得了。

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Oh, the dinner
party isn't finished yet.
It'll be over before
you even know it~
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哦，晚宴還沒結束呢。
不知不覺就會結束的~

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Well well, it looks like our
performance was a success.
The new girls did a really
great job. So let's head
back home, shall we?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
哎呀，看來我們的表演很成功。
新來的女孩們表現得非常出色。
那麼，我們回家吧？

scripts.text:
[Dancer]
Dancing is so fun, but
sometimes it's hard to
keep up with the audience's
expectations, you know?
scripts.translation:
[舞娘]
跳舞很有趣，但有時候很難跟上觀眾們的期望，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Manager]
It'd be a really great
party if our customers
were a little less rowdy
Recently, they've been
more than a handful...
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
如果顧客們能稍微安靜一點就好了。
最近他們真的讓人有點難以招架...

scripts.text:
[Manager]
I'm glad our customers
enjoyed the performance
I was a little worried about
what they were going to think,
but I guess I was just being
overly anxious about it all.
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
很高興顧客們喜歡這場表演。
我原本有點擔心他們的看法，看來是我多慮了。

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Thank you so much for
your services. I'll be sure to
have one of my employees
send you your payment
Have a safe trip back~
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
非常感謝你們的服務。
我會讓一位員工把報酬送過去。
祝你們一路順風~

scripts.text:
[Manager]
Oh, did you enjoy
your trip? I'm glad to
see that everyone arrived
safely. The dinner party
will start shortly, so
please get ready~
scripts.translation:
[管理員]
哦，旅途愉快嗎？
很高興看到大家都安全抵達。
晚宴即將開始，請做好準備~

scripts.text:
[Employee]
We've been so busy lately!
It's just one party reservation
after another! When will I be
able to just take a break?
scripts.translation:
[員工]
最近太忙了！
一個接一個的宴會預訂！
我什麼時候才能休息一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Hi, how may I help you?
Tonight, most of customers
are high ranking government
officials or public figures.
That man over there is the
Rekenber P.R. executive.
scripts.translation:
[員工]
您好，有什麼可以幫您？
今晚，大多數顧客都是高階政府官員或公眾人物。
那邊那位男士是雷根貝勒的公關主管。

scripts.text:
[Employee]
That priest over there is
actually a diplomat from
Arunafeltz on business.
These are some very
important people!
scripts.translation:
[員工]
那邊那位牧師其實是阿魯納佩茨出差來的外交官。
這些都是非常重要的人物！

scripts.text:
[Employee]
How can I help you?
Oh, would you like another
drink? There you go! Please
enjoy the dinner party~
scripts.translation:
[員工]
有什麼可以幫您？
哦，您想再來一杯嗎？
給您！
請享用晚宴~

scripts.text:
[Employee]
Oh, the mess left after
a banquet is the biggest
part of my job. It's tough
work, but it needs to get done.
scripts.translation:
[員工]
哦，宴會後的清理工作是我工作中最繁重的一部分。
雖然很辛苦，但必須做好。

scripts.text:
[????]
I guess the party
will soon be over.
Did you enjoy yourself?
scripts.translation:
[????]
我想宴會快結束了。玩得開心嗎？

scripts.text:
[??????]
Yes, thank you, I had
a great time. I'm sorry
I gave you such short
notice of my arrival, but
you held this party anyway.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
是的，謝謝，我玩得很開心。抱歉我這麼突然才通知你，但你們還是為我舉辦了這場宴會。

scripts.text:
[????]
Don't mention it.
You're a valued guest.
It would shame me if I'd
failed to entertain you.
scripts.translation:
[????]
別客氣。您是貴客，若沒能招待好您，那才是我的恥辱。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Ho ho, you certainly know
how to be a good host~
scripts.translation:
[??????]
呵呵，您真是一位好主人~

scripts.text:
[????]
Your words honor me.
scripts.translation:
[????]
承蒙誇獎，不勝榮幸。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe man took a quick
look around the room.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF那名男子迅速環顧了一下四周。^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
No one's around.
I have something to
discuss with you before
we get down to business.
scripts.translation:
[????]
這裡沒人。在談正事之前，我有件事要和你商量。

scripts.text:
[??????]
What kind of...?

[????]
I'll explain in detail
someplace safer. The gist
is that some rogues over in
Arunafeltz are plotting to harm
relations between Arunafeltz
and the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[????]
我會找個更安全的地方詳細說明。簡單來說，阿魯納佩茨有些惡徒正密謀破壞阿魯納佩茨與雷根貝勒公司的關係。

scripts.text:
[??????]
Oh... I see. Yes,
we can't talk about
that here. To tell the
truth, I've suspected that
something like that was
going on... Yes, makes sense.
scripts.translation:
[??????]
哦...我明白了。
是的，我們不能在這裡談論那些。
說實話，我也一直懷疑會有類似的事情發生...是的，說得通。

scripts.text:
[????]
We should relocate
so that we can talk
a bit more freely.
Please follow me,
I already have
a place prepared.
scripts.translation:
[????]
我們應該換個地方，這樣說話能更自由些。
請跟我來，我已經準備好一個地方了。

scripts.text:
[????]
Hmm... Good.
Everything looks
ready to me.
scripts.translation:
[????]
嗯...很好。
在我看來，一切都準備就緒了。

scripts.text:
[??????]
I've got to say, only
Rekenber can host such
a magnificent party in
a city this polluted.
What's going on...?
scripts.translation:
[??????]
不得不說，只有雷根貝勒才能在這座汙染嚴重的城市裡舉辦如此盛大的宴會。
這是怎麼回事...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Thanks for your help.
This country's government
should know better than to
put a good man like me in jail.
Listen, I'm a fugitive now.
Do you think you can help me?
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
謝謝你的幫助。
這個國家的政府竟然要把像我這樣的好人關進監獄。
聽著，我現在是個逃犯。
你覺得你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: I may as well...
scripts.translation: 我也可以

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
I just need you to talk
to a few people, and let
me know what they said.
I'd do it myself, but you
understand that I've got
to keep a low profile.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
我只需要你找幾個人談談，然後告訴我他們說了什麼。
我自己去也行，但你知道的，我必須保持低調。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Please meet these people
in the order that I tell you.
I've sent messengers to let
them know of your arrival,
but I had to send them out
at different times... Anyway...
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
請按照我告訴你的順序去見這些人。
我已經派信使去通知他們你的到來，但我不得不讓他們在不同時間出發...總之...

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
First, go to Prontera
and talk to Chada. Second,
go to Geffen and speak to
Ghez. Lastly, please go to
Comodo and meet Nosdan.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
首先，去普隆德拉找查達。
其次，去吉芬找蓋茲。
最後，請去克魔島找諾斯丹。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Each one of them will
sing you a song. Listen
carefully, and sing me their
songs when you come back.
Thanks, you have no idea how
much I appreciate your help.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
他們每個人都會給你唱一首歌。
仔細聽，等你回來時把他們的歌唱給我聽。
謝謝，你不知道我有多感激你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Chada is probably near
the middle of Prontera.
The messenger I sent to
him should have reached
him by now, so he should
be expecting your arrival.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
查達可能在普隆德拉的中間位置。
我派給他的信使應該已經到達那裡了，所以他應該正在期待你的到來。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Ah, now you've got to
talk to Ghez. He should
be in Northeast Geffen
somewhere. Hopefully
you won't have too much
trouble finding him.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
啊，現在你得去找蓋茲了。
他應該在吉芬的東北方某處。
希望你能順利找到他。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Trying to find Nosdan?
I think he's probably in the
Northern Cave in Comodo.
Please talk to him, and let
me know about his song.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
在找諾斯丹嗎？
我想他可能在克魔島的北方洞穴裡。
請和他談談，並告訴我他的歌。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Welcome back.
So did you listen
to all of their songs?
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
歡迎回來。
那麼，你聽完了他們所有的歌嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Perfect~ Here's a little
something to show my
gratitude. Hope you like it.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
完美~ 這裡有一點小東西以表謝意。
希望你喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Now, tell me, what
exactly did they si--
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
現在，告訴我，他們到底唱了什--

scripts.text:
[????]
Hold it!

[Vitre]
What? Wh-who the
hell are you guys?!
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
什麼？
你...你們到底是哪路神仙？！

scripts.text:
[????]
Rune-Midgarts
Secret Service!
Vitre Bizlleta--
you're under arrest
for espionage!
scripts.translation:
[????]
盧恩·米德加茲秘密服務處！維特雷·比茲利塔——你因間諜罪被捕了！

scripts.text:
[Vitre]
Again? Didn't you just
arrest me just for being
suspected of espionage?
I think it's a little unfair
to just capture me when
you don't have any proof.
scripts.translation:
[維特雷]
又來？
你們剛才不是才因為“涉嫌”間諜罪抓過我嗎？
在沒有證據的情況下就這樣抓人，我覺得有點不公平吧。

scripts.text:
[????]
We just seized concrete
evidence of your illegal
activities. It's probably
enough to imprison you
for life. Happy now?
scripts.translation:
[????]
