你...你找到我妹妹了嗎？
她沒事吧？
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I found her,
she's alright but...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我找到她了，她沒事，但是...

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
What? Why isn't
she with you?
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
什麼？
為什麼她不在你身邊？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Curdie is... Well, she's
been shackled down. We
need to find a way to free her.
Do you know where there's
a forge or a locksmith that
might be able to help her?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
柯迪...嗯，她被腳鐐鎖住了。我們得想辦法解開。
你知道哪裡有鐵匠鋪或鎖匠能幫忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Oh! Oh, there's a
locksmith in the market
street! You can ask him
to help free Curdie!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
哦！市場街上有個鎖匠！你可以請他幫忙解開柯迪的腳鐐！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Let's see...
I'd better find the
locksmith in the market
street, and ask him to help
me unlock Curdie's shackles.
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
讓我想想...我得去市場街找那個鎖匠，請他幫我解開柯迪的腳鐐。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Huh... I'd better talk
to Mr. Lockenlock first, the
locksmith in the market street.
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嗯...我得先去找洛肯洛克先生，市場街上的鎖匠。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... I'd better talk
to Ms. Ivory, the organic
soap maker if I want to help
Karyn free his sister Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...如果我想幫卡琳解救她妹妹柯迪，最好去找有機肥皂製造商艾薇女士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait... I should be
bringing Ms. Ivory all
of the soap ingredients.
What were they again...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...我應該給艾薇女士帶齊所有的肥皂原料。
那些是什麼來著...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF10 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF100 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Jellopies^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Empty Bottles^000000.
I better get those...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF10瓶牛奶^000000，
^4D4DFF100份綠色藥草^000000，
^4D4DFF50個傑勒比結晶^000000，
以及^4D4DFF5個空瓶^000000。
我得去收集這些...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to talk to
someone named Saraman
to get the soap ingredients...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要找個人叫薩拉曼，去獲取肥皂原料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
I need to bring
Mr. Saruman all the
things he needs to
stimulate a camel's 
appetite. I need to get...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我想想...我得給薩拉曼先生帶齊刺激駱駝食慾的東西。我需要...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Monster's Feed^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Empty Bottle^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.

[{0}]
I have everything I need
to stimulate a camel's
appetite. Now I need to
feed the camel so that I can
get the soap ingredients and
5 lumps of camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已經備齊了刺激駱駝食慾的東西。
現在我需要喂駱駝，這樣才能拿到肥皂原料和5塊駱駝糞便。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, my time
would be better spent
looking for the Silk Sand
Camel for the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在，我的時間最好用來尋找絲沙駱駝，以獲取原料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better find Mr. Saraman's
lost camel, feed it camel
appetite stimulants, and
then get the soap ingredient
and 5 lumps of camel dung
if I want to free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得找到薩拉曼先生丟失的駱駝，餵它開胃劑，然後拿到肥皂原料和5坨駱駝糞便，才能解救柯迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I found the
camel. Now I need to get
all the soap ingredients.
The sooner I do that, the
sooner I can help Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我找到了駱駝。
現在我需要集齊所有的肥皂原料。
越快完成，我就能越快幫到柯迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredient and 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料和5塊駱駝糞便。
我該回去告訴薩拉曼先生他的駱駝在哪裡，然後再去找艾薇小姐。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
Shouldn't I be going
to see Ms. Ivory now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我想想...
我現在應該去找艾薇小姐嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have the Silk Sand Camel
Soap now, so I should go
bring it to Mr. Lockenlock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在有了絲沙駱駝肥皂，應該把它帶給洛肯洛克先生。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better use the soap to
make a key mold that I can
bring over to Mr. Lockenlock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我最好用肥皂做一個鑰匙模具，然後帶給洛肯洛克先生。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Making the key is more
important that telling Karyn
about what's happened.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
做鑰匙比告訴卡琳發生了什麼更重要。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to bring
1 Steel to Mr. Lockenlock
so that he can make a key
that will finally free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要帶1塊鋼鐵給洛肯洛克先生，讓他製作一把鑰匙，這樣才能解救柯迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I finally got the
key that I can use
to free Curdie. I'm
gonna go save her now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我終於拿到了可以解救柯迪的鑰匙。
我現在就去救她。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Thank you so much!
Please bring back Curdie
as soon as you can! ^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
非常感謝你！
請快點把柯迪帶回來！
^333333*嗚嗚*^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, Karyn! I sent
your sister back to town
with a Butterfly Wing.
Did she come back safe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，卡琳！
我派你姐姐帶著蝴蝶翅膀回城鎮了。
她安全回來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Yes, Curdie's back
and she's resting in
the hospital right now.
Thank you so much for
all of your help!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
是的，柯迪回來了，她正在醫院休息。
非常感謝你的幫助！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
I'm not sure what's wrong
with Curdie, though. Ever
since she got back, she gets
frightened whenever she
sees the soldiers in town.
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
不過我不清楚柯迪怎麼了。
自從她回來，每次看到城鎮裡計程車兵都會害怕。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
I promise to tell my dad
about what you did after he
comes back from overseas.
Thank you for everything
that you did for us!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
我答應爸爸，等他從海外回來就告訴他你做的事。
謝謝你為我們做的一切！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm... I see...
I'll come by later
when Curdie's released
from the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我知道了。
等柯迪出院後我會再來看她的。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Yes, please do.
I promise to help you
whenever you need me!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
好的，請一定來。
我答應你，只要你需要，我都會幫忙！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hahahaha!
Well... I guess that's
pretty reassuring. Until then,
take good care of your mother
and sister. You got that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈哈哈哈!！
嗯...那還挺讓人安心的。
在那之前，照顧好你的母親和姐姐。
記住了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Got it!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
記住了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good, good...
It's a promise, then.
I'll see you later~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
很好，很好...
那就說定了。
回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Oh, hello! Thank you
so much for helping me
last time! When I get
older, I'm gonna do my
best to help you the same
way that you helped me!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
哦，你好！
上次謝謝你幫我！
等我長大了，我會盡力像你幫助我那樣去幫助別人！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Hi! It's good to see
you again! Kurdi just came
back home from the hospital,
and is getting better everyday!
Ah, and I've been taking care
of her, just like I promised~
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嗨！
很高興再見到你！
柯迪剛從醫院回家，每天都好多了！
啊，而且我一直在照顧她，就像我答應的那樣~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Really? That's good
You should be proud~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真的嗎？
那很好。
你應該感到自豪~

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
^666666*Blush*^000000 Heh heh!

[{0}]
Anyway, I was wondering
if you could help me.
Your dad's a fisherman,
right? Would you mind
asking him if I could
borrow his boat?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對了，我想請你幫個忙。
你爸爸是漁夫，對吧？
能不能麻煩你問問他，我能不能借用他的船？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Well... Actually...
The pope said that my
dad isn't allowed to use
his boat for a while...
I'm not sure why...
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嗯...其實...
教皇說，我爸爸暫時不能使用他的船...
我不太清楚為什麼...

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
So yeah. Dad's not allowed
to go out to sea right now.
But it should be okay if it's
you, right? Hey, you helped
me, so I hafta help you, right?
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
所以呢。
爸爸現在不能出海。
但如果是你的話，應該沒問題吧？
嘿，你幫過我，所以我得幫你，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
My dad is really mad that
he can't use his boat so
maybe we better not tell
him you want to use it. Let's
keep it our secret, okay?
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
我爸爸因為不能用船很生氣，所以最好別告訴他你想用船。
讓我們保守這個秘密，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
S-sure thing!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
當...當然沒問題！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Anyway, his boat is the
only one on the south beach
since all the other fishermen
dock theirs boats in other
places. Also, my dad's boat
will rust if no one uses it.
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
總之，他的船是南邊海灘上唯一的一艘，因為其他漁夫都把船停泊在別處。
而且，如果沒人使用，我爸爸的船會生鏽的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great! Thanks so much
for your help, Karyn~
I'll be sure to take
good care of your dad's
boat. I only need it for
a little while, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太好了！
非常感謝你的幫助，卡琳~我會好好照顧你爸爸的船。
反正我只需要借用一小會兒。

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Heh heh! Thanks!
I'm happy that
I can help you too!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嘿嘿!！謝謝！
我也很高興能幫到你！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Hi! How do you like
fishing on my dad's boat?
Oh, and Kurdi says hi!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
嗨！在我爸爸的船上釣魚感覺怎麼樣？
哦，柯迪向你問好！

scripts.text:
[Kid Karyn]
Dad says that he'll
be able to go fishing
again soon! I hope that
he'll catch a lot of fish!
scripts.translation:
[小孩 卡琳]
爸爸說，他很快就能再次去釣魚了！
希望他能釣到很多魚！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou come across
a little girl lying on the
ground unconscious.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現一個小女孩躺在地上，失去了意識。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, kid! Wake up!
Can you hear me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，小孩！醒醒！
你能聽到我說話嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFShe has a pulse, but
despite your verbal
entreaties, she won't
open her eyes. You
lightly slap her cheek
to wake her up.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF她有脈搏，但儘管你不斷呼喚，她依然沒有睜開眼睛。
你輕輕拍了拍她的臉頰，試圖喚醒她。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Huh?!
...Ah, owwww~
W-waaaaaaaah!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
嗯？！
...啊，好痛~
嗚...哇啊啊啊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry! I didn't mean
to make you cry! Are...
Are you alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
對不起！我不是故意讓你哭的！你...
你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Huh? Wh-who are you?
Oh no, you have to get
out of here! You'll be in
trouble if they catch you!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
嗯？
你...你是誰？
糟糕，你必須馬上離開這裡！
如果被他們抓到，你就麻煩了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you Curdie?
Your brother Karyn
asked me to rescue you.
Come on, we've got to
get you out of here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是柯迪嗎？
你哥哥卡琳讓我來救你。
快起來，我們必須帶你離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Karyn...?
Oh, oh no! I... They
locked me in these
shackles and I can't move!
You have to leave before
those scary men come back!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
卡琳...？
糟糕！我...他們用腳鐐鎖住了我，我動不了！
你必須在那些可怕的人回來之前離開！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What...?!
Those bastards!
Tying up a little
girl like this...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什...什麼？！
這群混蛋！
竟然把一個小女孩綁成這樣...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Argh! And I can't just
use brute force to shatter
these shackles! I might
end up hurting you...!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可惡！
我不能直接用蠻力砸碎這些腳鐐！
萬一傷到你怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Don't worry about me...
Just hurry and leave!
I... I'll be alright! Now
hurry! Someone's coming!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
別擔心我...
快離開這裡！
我...我會沒事的！
快走吧！有人來了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, I'll go...
But sit tight, and
wait for me to come
back. I'll figure out
some way to free you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我走了...但你乖乖待著，等我回來。我會想辦法解開你的腳鐐。

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
^333333*Sob*^000000 R-really...?

[{0}]
I promise.
I'm sure that someone
in town will know of a way
to unlock your shackles.
I'll be back as soon as I can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我保證。
鎮上一定有人知道怎麼解開你的腳鐐。
我會盡快回來的！

scripts.text:
^3355FFSomeone in town
must have the
expertise to unlock
these shackles. It's your
only hope to free Curdie
from these chains.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF鎮上一定有人懂得如何解開這些腳鐐。這是你解救柯迪的唯一希望。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie is lying
feebly on the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF柯迪虛弱地躺在地上。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
I hate the metal
clanging sounds...
Th-the sparks,
they're... They're...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
我討厭金屬碰撞的聲音...那...那火花，它們...它們...

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie is curled up on
the ground, eyes tightly
shut, her entire body
trembling with fear.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF柯迪蜷縮在地上，緊閉雙眼，全身因恐懼而顫抖。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOn the ground, you see
some equipment that looks
similarly to that used by
the Rachel soldiers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF地上散落著一些看起來像是拉赫士兵使用的裝備。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt seems that someone
has come by to give
Curdie food and water.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看來有人來過，給柯迪留下了食物和水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie squints at you
as you walk by. It seems
that her vision gets worse
the longer she's locked
up in this cave.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你走過時，柯迪眯著眼看你。
看來她被關在這個洞穴裡的時間越長，視力就越差。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better find the
Silk Sand Camel and get
the soap ingredients if
you really want to free
Curdie from her shackles.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF如果你真的想解開柯迪的腳鐐，最好去找絲沙駱駝並收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better find Mr. Saraman's
lost camel, feed it camel
appetite stimulants, and
then get the soap ingredient
and 5 lumps of camel dung
if I want to free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得找到薩拉曼先生丟失的駱駝，餵它駱駝開胃劑，然後拿到肥皂原料和5塊駱駝糞便，這樣才能解救柯迪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou already found the
camel, so you need to collect
the soap ingredients if you
want to free Curdie.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然你已經找到了駱駝，那麼如果你真想解開柯迪的腳鐐，就需要收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredients: 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料：5塊駱駝糞便。
我應該回去告訴薩拉曼他的駱駝在哪裡，然後再去找艾薇女士。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should be leaving
to see Ms. Ivory now if
you really want to free
Curdie from her shackles.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF如果你真的想解開柯迪的腳鐐，現在應該去找艾薇女士。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow that you have the
Silk Sand Camel Soap,
you should bring it
over to Mr. Lockenlock.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然你已經拿到了絲沙駱駝肥皂，你應該把它帶給洛肯洛克。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie is exactly
where you left her.
There's a bowl of cold
soup next to her, so it's
clear that someone has
been feeding her.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF柯迪還留在原地。
她旁邊有一碗冷湯，看來一直有人在照顧她。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou pour the soap into
the shackle's lock to create
a mold that Mr. Lockenlock
can use to make a key.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你把肥皂倒進腳鐐的鎖孔中，做出一個模具，讓洛肯洛克用它來配鑰匙。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Will...
Will I always
be stuck here?
I... I want my mommy...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
我...我會永遠被困在這裡嗎？
我...我想媽媽了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... You're awake?
Don't worry, Curdie,
I'm sure that I'll be
able to get you free soon.
Try to hold on a bit longer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊...你醒了？
別擔心，柯迪，我相信很快就能把你救出去的。
再堅持一下。

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
When the door is open,
I see blazing flames...
And I hear... the sound
of machines? These men
wearing the same clothes
keep marching past me...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
門開啟的時候，我看到熊熊烈火...還聽到...機器的聲音？
那些穿著同樣衣服的人一直從我面前走過...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
I... They scare me so much!
Th-the man that brings me
food says that they won't
let me go because of what
I saw inside there. They...
They won't let be go home...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
我...他們好可怕！給我送飯的男人說，因為我看到了裡面的東西，他們不讓我走...他們不讓我回家...

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie's eyes are
disfocused and are
pointed above your head.
She might not survive if
she's forced to remain
here for much longer.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF柯迪的眼神渙散，望著你的頭頂上方。
如果她再在這裡待太久，可能活不下去了。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry.
I'll come rescue
you as soon as I make
the key to unlock these
awful shackles. Don't worry...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心。等我做好開啟這副可怕腳鐐的鑰匙，就會來救你。別擔心...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
If I'm not here the
next time you come,
then just run away.
Don't even tell my brother.
Get far away before they
can catch you. I-I'm serious...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
如果我下次不在這裡了，你就快跑。連我哥哥都不要告訴。在他們抓住你之前跑遠點。我...我是認真的...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Even if I don't see you
again... I just... I just
want to thank you for doing
your best to help me.
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
即使再也見不到你...我也...我只想謝謝你盡力幫助我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everything will be
alright. I just have
to hurry a little bit.
Alright, it's time to go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一切都會好起來的。
我只是需要加快速度。
好了，該走了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou extract the soap
from the lock, and
carefully wrap it.
Now you need to take
the mold back to town
to Mr. Lockenlock.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你從鎖孔中取出肥皂，小心地包裹好。
現在你需要帶著模具回到城鎮，去找洛肯洛克。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou have to hurry back
to town and bring the
key mold to Mr. Lockenlock
so that he can make a key
to unlock Curdie's shackles.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你必須儘快回城，把鑰匙模具帶給洛肯洛克，讓他配一把鑰匙解開柯迪的腳鐐。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Y-you...
Is it really you?
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
你...你...
真的是你嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hang on, Curdie!
I hope this key works...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
堅持住，柯迪！
希望這把鑰匙能開啟...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou unlock the
shackles with
Mr. Lockenlock's key.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你用洛肯洛克的鑰匙解開了腳鐐。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Aaaah!
M-my... My...!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
啊啊！
我...我的...！

scripts.text:
^3355FFCurdie's legs are
swollen from the
weight and pressure
of wearing the shackles
for such a long time.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF柯迪的雙腿因長時間佩戴腳鐐而腫脹。^000000

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
I can't move my legs!
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
我的腿動不了了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, there's no other
choice. Curdie, I'm
going to send you back to
town with a Butterfly Wing.
Try not to move, alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看來別無選擇了。柯迪，我要用蝴蝶翅膀把你送回城裡。儘量不要動，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
Oh! Thank you...
I... I can go home...
Thank you s-so much...
scripts.translation:
[小 柯迪]
哦！謝謝你...
我...我可以回家了...
太...太感謝你了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou use the power
of a Butterfly Wing to
send Curdie back to
town. Hopefully, she'll
arrive safely and see
her brother Karyn again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你藉助蝴蝶翅膀的力量把柯迪送回城裡。希望她能平安抵達，再次見到哥哥卡琳。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What did she see behind
the steel door in this old
volcano? It must have been
dangerous... Something
related to the Rachel Army...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她在火山深處的鐵門後看到了什麼？
那裡一定很危險...可能與拉赫軍隊有關...

scripts.text:
[Little Curdie]
 ...Wah....

^3355FFIt's a drunkard...
The scent of pure
alcohol wafts around him.
There's a certain beauty
to his disheveled misery.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF是個酒鬼...
他身上散發著純酒精的氣味。
他那凌亂落魄的模樣竟透著一種獨特的美感。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...?

[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Huh? Arrrgh...
My head... What
do you want?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
嗯？啊...
我的頭...你想幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I'd like
to make a key.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我想配一把鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Keys? Yeah, yeah...
That's what I do.
If you've got the lock,
it'll be a piece of cake.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
鑰匙？對對對...
那是我的老本行。
如果你有鎖，那簡直是小菜一碟。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Ugh, but I'm so thirsty
and this headache is
killing me. You mind
bringing me a Yellow
Potion first?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
唉，但我太渴了，這頭痛得要命。
你介意先給我帶一瓶黃色藥水嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure, I guess.
I can part with just
1 Yellow Potion.
Here you go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我想。
我可以拿出一瓶黃色藥水。
給你。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Ah, that hit the spot!
Wait, wait... Now I feel
dizzy... What's going...
What's going on...?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
啊，真解渴！
等等，等等...我現在有點頭暈...怎麼回事...
發生什麼事了...？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Okay, okay...
I'm alright now.
So what'd you say you
needed? A key? Did you
bring the lock with you?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
好了，好了...
我現在沒事了。
剛才你說你需要什麼？
鑰匙？你帶鎖過來了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
I'm an expert in crafting
keys and locks. Hell, my locks
are strong enough to hold down
a dragon, you know that? I'll
have you know that the Rachel
Army's a regular customer~
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
我是製作鑰匙和鎖的專家。我的鎖堅固得足以困住一條龍！順便告訴你，拉赫軍隊可是我的常客~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333This guy made locks for
the Rachel army?! It might
not be a good idea to let him
know that I'm trying to free
one of their prisoners. Who
knows if he's loyal to them?^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333這傢伙給拉赫軍隊做鎖？！
也許不該讓他知道我正在試圖解救他們的一名囚犯。
誰知道他是否忠於他們？^000000)

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what happened was...
I lost my key, but I can't
bring the lock here with me.
I think I'd end up breaking
it if I brought it with me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
事情是這樣的...
我弄丟了鑰匙，但我沒法把鎖帶到這裡。
我覺得如果我把它帶過來，可能會把它弄壞。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Oh, yeah? No problem.
Just take me to the lock.
I'll charge you extra, though,
especially since my knees
are going bad. So where
are we going exactly?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
哦，是嗎？
沒問題。
帶我去看看鎖。
不過我要額外收費，畢竟我的膝蓋不太好。
那我們具體要去哪裡？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait!
We can't do that!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等！
我們不能那樣做！

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
What do you mean?
You're not trying to
open up a bank safe
or something, are you?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
你什麼意思？
你不會是想開啟銀行保險櫃之類的吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, it's nothing like
that! It's just that the lock
is in a dangerous place.
This is really important...
Please, you have to help me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，完全不是那樣！
只是那把鎖在一個危險的地方。
這真的很重要...
拜託，你一定要幫我！

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Huh. Well, bottom line,
I can't make a key without
looking at the lock. Let me
think of a way I can help you.
Give me a second, will you?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
嗯。
總之，不看鎖我是沒法配鑰匙的。
讓我想想怎麼幫你。
給我一點時間，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
...............................
Well, I guess you can try
to make a mold of the lock.
It'll have to be perfect, so
this'll get pretty expensive.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
...
嗯，我想你可以試著製作鎖的模具。必須做得完全吻合，所以費用會很高。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Go to the market and
find a lady selling organic
soap. You need to get a bottle
of Chamelepu Soap. You will
need that exact type of soap:
nothing else will do.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
去市場找一位賣有機肥皂的女士，買一瓶變色龍肥皂。必須是那種肥皂，別的都不行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Chamelpu Soap?
What is th--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
變色龍肥皂？
那是什——

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
No time to explain.
You'd better hurry and
find her before she closes
shop for the day. The shop
owner's a beauty, so it'll
be tough for you to miss her.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
沒時間解釋了。
你最好快點去找她，趁她還沒收攤。
店主是個美人，你肯定一眼就能認出她。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a drunkard...
This man must be the
Mr. Lockenlock that you seek.
You'd better follow Toby's
advice and bring this man
a Yellow Potion first.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF是個酒鬼...這個人應該就是你找的洛肯洛克先生。
你最好聽從托比的建議，先給這個人帶一瓶黃色藥水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Go to the market and
find a lady selling organic
soap, and get a bottle of
Chamelepu Soap. You will
need that exact type of soap:
nothing else will do.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
去市場找一位賣有機肥皂的女士，買一瓶變色龍肥皂。必須是那種肥皂，別的都不行。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Chamelpu Soap?
What is th--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
變色龍肥皂？
那是什麼——

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
No time to explain.
You'd better hurry and
find her before she closes
shop for the day. The shop
owner's a beauty, so it'll
be tough for you to miss her.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
沒時間解釋了。
你最好快點去找她，趁她還沒收攤。
店主是個美人，你肯定一眼就能認出她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait... I should be
bringing Ms. Ivory all
of the soap ingredients.
What were they again...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...我應該給艾薇女士帶齊所有的肥皂原料。
那些是什麼來著...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF10 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF100 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Jellopies^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Empty Bottles^000000.
I better get those...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF10個牛奶^000000、^4D4DFF100個綠色藥草^000000、^4D4DFF50個傑勒比結晶^000000，還有^4D4DFF5個空瓶^000000。
我得去弄到這些...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to talk to
someone named Saraman
to get the soap ingredients...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要找個人叫薩拉曼，去獲取肥皂原料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
I need to bring
Mr. Saruman all the
things he needs to
stimulate a camel's 
appetite. I need to get...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我想想...我需要給薩拉曼先生帶齊他需要的東西，以刺激駱駝的食慾。
我需要去弄...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Monster's Feed^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Empty Bottle^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.

[{0}]
I have everything I need
to stimulate a camel's
appetite. Now I need to
feed the camel so that I can
get the soap ingredients and
5 lumps of camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已經備齊了刺激駱駝食慾的東西。
現在我需要喂駱駝，這樣才能拿到肥皂原料和5塊駱駝糞便。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, my time
would be better spent
looking for the Silk Sand
Camel for the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在，我的時間最好用來尋找絲沙駱駝，以獲取原料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better find Mr. Saraman's
lost camel, feed it camel
appetite stimulants, and
then get the soap ingredient
and 5 lumps of camel dung
if I want to free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得找到薩拉曼先生丟失的駱駝，餵它駱駝開胃劑，然後拿到肥皂原料和5塊駱駝糞便，這樣才能解救柯迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I found the
camel. Now I need to get
all the soap ingredients.
The sooner I do that, the
sooner I can help Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我找到了駱駝。
現在我需要集齊所有的肥皂原料。
越快完成，我就能越快幫到柯迪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou already found the
camel, so you need to collect
the soap ingredients if you
want to free Curdie.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然你已經找到了駱駝，那麼如果你真想解開柯迪的腳鐐，就需要收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredients: 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料：5塊駱駝糞便。
我應該回去告訴薩拉曼他的駱駝在哪裡，然後再去找艾薇女士。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
Shouldn't I be going
to see Ms. Ivory now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我想想...
我現在應該去找艾薇小姐嗎？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Oh, so you're finally
back with the Chamelpu
Soap. What took so long?
All you had to do was go
to the market and buy it.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
哦，你終於帶著變色龍肥皂回來了。
怎麼花了這麼久？
你只需要去市場買就行了。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Uh, anyway, did Ms. Ivory
tell you how to use the soap?
You just pour it into the
keyhole, and then pour the
soap back into the bottle.
Do it carefully and quickly.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
呃，總之，艾薇小姐有沒有告訴你怎麼用肥皂？
你只需要把它倒進鎖孔，然後再倒回瓶子裡。
動作要輕快。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Make sure you close the
bottle tightly when you're
done so no air gets into it.
If you take more than thirty
seconds, the soap won't retain
the lock's shape very well.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
做完後一定要把瓶蓋擰緊，別讓空氣進去。
如果你超過三十秒，肥皂就無法很好地保留鎖的形狀了。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Pour the liquid soap to the key hole in the lock,
pour the soap back to the bottle.
and close the lid so tightly that the air wouldn't go inside the bottle.
Remember, you can't take longer than 30 seconds to finish the procedures.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
把液態肥皂倒進鎖孔，再倒回瓶子裡。
然後擰緊瓶蓋，確保空氣進不去。
記住，整個過程不能超過30秒。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Finally, bring the bottle
back here for me so that
I can make the key. But when
you come back, I need to make
sure that the key you're making
isn't for anything illegal...
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
最後，把瓶子帶回來給我，這樣我才能配鑰匙。
不過等你回來時，我得確認你配的鑰匙不是用於非法用途...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Alright.

[{0}]
I'd better use the soap to
make a key mold that I can
bring over to Mr. Lockenlock.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我最好用肥皂做一個鑰匙模具，然後帶給洛肯洛克先生。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Oh, you're back...
So did you manage
to make the key mold?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
哦，你回來了...
那麼，你成功製作出鑰匙模具了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I did. Would you
please hurry? This is an
emergency, and it could
get really bad if I don't
get this key made soon...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的，我做到了。
請快點好嗎？
這是緊急情況，如果我不盡快拿到這把鑰匙，情況可能會變得非常糟糕...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Let me see... Well,
it's not really perfect, but
I should be able to fashion
a key for this lock. Ooh...
But you know what? I don't
have any materials on me.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
讓我看看...嗯，雖然不是很完美，但我應該能為這把鎖配一把鑰匙。
噢...不過你知道嗎？
我身上沒有材料。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
I've already made all
the keys and locks for this
town, so no one's really had
to send in any orders lately.
That's why I didn't have any
materials onhand. Sorry.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
我已經為這座城鎮配好了所有的鑰匙和鎖，所以最近沒人需要下單定製。
因此我手頭沒有材料。
抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
All I need is ^4D4DFF1 Steel^000000.
It won't take me more
than five minutes to make
the key, so I can get it done
as soon as you can bring
me the Steel. I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
我只需要^4D4DFF1塊鋼鐵^000000。配鑰匙不會超過五分鐘，只要你把鋼鐵帶來，我很快就能做好。我會等你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here's the Steel that
you need. Would you
please make the key now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是你需要的鋼。
請現在幫我配鑰匙好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
...............................
I've been studying
this key mold, and
I just realized something...
Tell me right now: what
are you using this key for?
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
...我一直在研究這個鑰匙模具，我突然意識到一件事...現在告訴我：你打算用這把鑰匙做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
What are you...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
誒...？
你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
I asked you first.
Tell me what you intend
to do with this key! If you
don't, I can't help you.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
是我先問你的。
告訴我你打算用這把鑰匙做什麼！
如果你不說，我就不能幫你。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Don't lie to me.
This mold... This is
the lock for the shackles
that I've made under the
orders of the Rachel Army.
I have the master key for that.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
別騙我。
這個模具...這是拉赫軍隊委託我製作的腳鐐鎖。
我手裡有這副腳鐐的萬能鑰匙。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
These shackles are only
supposed to be used for
prisoners! If I release one
of them, they will hunt you
down and hold me accountable.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
這些腳鐐只用於囚犯！如果我放走其中一個囚犯，他們會追捕你，還會追究我的責任。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The truth is... I really
am trying to free somebody
the Rachel Army imprisoned...
She's Curdie, a young girl
that they locked up in
Thor Volcano...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
事實是...我確實想救一個被拉赫軍隊關押的人...她是柯迪，一個被關在火山裡的年輕女孩...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
What...?!
Are you serious?
Y-you're... No way.
You're not lying. This...
I'm sorry. You shouldn't
have gotten involved, but...
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
什...麼？！
你是認真的嗎？
你...不可能。
你沒有在撒謊。這...
對不起。你不該捲入這件事，但是...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Oh God!
They... They
really imprisoned
an innocent child?!
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
天哪！
他們...他們真的把一個無辜的孩子關起來了？！

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Here. Take it.
Take the master key.
Bring it to Thor Volcano
and rescue that poor kid.
We could get in a lot of
trouble for doing this, but...
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
給你，拿著這把萬能鑰匙。帶去托爾火山，救出那個可憐的孩子。這樣做我們可能會惹上大麻煩，但是...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
My conscience won't allow
them to do something like
this. Rescue that kid, and
then throw the key away
somewhere when you're done.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
我的良心不允許他們這樣做。救出那個孩子後，找個地方把鑰匙扔掉。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
That way, if the army
comes to interrogate me,
I'll just say that it was
stolen from my shop by
some thief. I should get
rid of all my keys too...
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
這樣，如果軍隊來審問我，我就說鑰匙是被小偷從店裡偷走的。我也該把其他鑰匙都處理掉...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Hurry up and go!
Make sure that you
bring that child back
safe to her family!
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
快去吧！
一定要把那個孩子平安地帶回家人身邊！

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
All I need is ^4D4DFF1 Steel^000000.
It won't take me more
than five minutes to make
the key, so I can get it done
as soon as you can bring
me the Steel. I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
我只需要^4D4DFF1塊鋼^000000。
配鑰匙不會超過五分鐘，所以只要你把鋼帶給我，我馬上就能做好。
我會等你的。

scripts.text:

Here. Take it.
Take the master key.
Bring it to Thor Volcano
and rescue that poor kid.
We could get in a lot of
trouble for doing this, but...
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
給你。拿著。
拿著這把萬能鑰匙。
帶去火山，救出那個可憐的孩子。
這樣做我們可能會惹上大麻煩，但是...

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Hurry up and go!
Make sure that you
bring that child back
safe to her family!
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
快去吧！
一定要把那個孩子平安地帶回家人身邊！

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Hey, that kid you saved...
Curdie. She's safely back
in town. I feel so responsible
about what happened. I mean,
she was locked up in shackles
that I designed for the army.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
嘿，你救的那個孩子...柯迪。她平安回到鎮上了。
我對發生的事很自責，畢竟她被我為軍隊設計的腳鐐鎖住了。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Anyway, I'm packing my
things. I'm thinking of
leaving this town for good.
The army's rotten to the core
for doing something like this.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
總之，我正在收拾東西。
我想徹底離開這座城鎮。
軍隊腐朽到了骨子裡，竟然做出這種事。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
You're a real good person,
and I'm glad I got to know
you. I don't know if we'll
ever meet again, but it's
good that there are people
like you in this world.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
你是個好人，很高興能認識你。
我不知道我們是否還會再見面，但這個世界有像你這樣的人真好。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Hey, that kid you saved...
Curdie. She's safely back
in town. I feel so responsible
about what happened. I mean,
she was locked up in shackles
that I designed for the army.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
嘿，你救的那個孩子...柯迪。
她平安地回到了鎮上。
我對發生的事感到很自責。
畢竟，她是被我為軍隊設計的腳鐐鎖住的。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
Anyway, I'm packing my
things. I'm thinking of
leaving this town for good.
The army's rotten to the core
for doing something like this.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
總之，我正在收拾東西。
我想徹底離開這座城鎮。
軍隊腐朽到了骨子裡，竟然做出這種事。

scripts.text:
[Locksmith Lockenlock]
You're a real good person,
and I'm glad I got to know
you. I don't know if we'll
ever meet again, but it's
good that there are people
like you in this world.
scripts.translation:
[鎖匠 洛肯洛克]
你是個好人，很高興能認識你。
我不知道我們是否還會再見面，但這個世界有像你這樣的人真好。

scripts.text:
[Lockenlock]
Zzzz...
Zzzz... Argh!
...Zzz...

^3355FFHe's drunk and
fast asleep.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF他喝醉了，正在熟睡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
I need to make more of
my soap, but I've run out
of ingredients. Well, there's
not much I can do without them,
so maybe it'd be better if
I just close up shop today...
scripts.translation:
[有機肥皂製造商 艾薇]
我還得做更多肥皂，可原料已經用完了。沒有原料我也做不了什麼，今天干脆關門好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...?

[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Oh, I'm sorry, but I'm
closing shop right now
because I just ran out of
soap ingredients. If you
ordered something, then you
could just come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
哦，抱歉，我現在要關門了，因為肥皂原料剛用完。
如果你訂了東西，可以明天再來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, this is an emergency!
Mr. Lockenlock told me to
come here to get some kind
of special soap. I need it
to make a mold for him
to make a key for me...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，這是緊急情況！
洛肯洛克先生讓我來這裡拿一種特殊的肥皂。
我需要它來給他做模具，好讓他給我配一把鑰匙...

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Oh? You locked yourself
out? Ah, Mr. Lockenlock
must have been talking
about my organic Chamelepu
soap. It's an artistic soap
that you can shape easily~
scripts.translation:
[有機肥皂製造商 艾薇]
哦？你把自己鎖在外面了？啊，洛肯洛克先生說的應該是我的有機變色龍肥皂。它是一種很容易塑形的藝術肥皂~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, that's right!
Chamelepu Soap!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯，就是那個！
變色龍肥皂！

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
My Chamelepu Soap
is pretty popular. It's
a liquid soap that you can
pour into anything, and it'll
harden into any shape that
you want. Neat, huh?
scripts.translation:
[有機肥皂製造商 艾薇]
我的變色龍肥皂很受歡迎。它是液態肥皂，倒進任何容器後都會凝固成你想要的形狀。很神奇吧？

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Well, as I told you earlier,
I ran out of every soap ingredient,
so I cannot make any more soap today.
You should come back tomorrow evening
if you want to buy the soap.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
嗯，正如我之前告訴你的，我的肥皂原料都用完了，所以今天無法再製作肥皂了。
如果你想買肥皂，最好明天晚上再來。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
If you really need it
right away, I can still
make it for you if can
bring all the ingredients.
They might be a bit hard
to obtain, though...
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
如果你現在非常急需，只要你能帶來所有原料，我還可以為你製作。
不過，有些原料可能不太好找...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's fine. The
important thing for me
is to get this soap as
soon as I possibly can!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒關係。
對我來說，最重要的是儘快拿到這塊肥皂！

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Alright, first I want
you to bring me the basic
stuff. Bring these items
in the exact amounts I ask
for, alright? Ratios are pretty
important in making soap.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
好吧，首先我要你帶一些基礎材料。
請按照我要求的確切數量帶來，好嗎？
製作肥皂時，比例是非常重要的。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
^4D4DFF10 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF100 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Jellopies^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Empty Bottles^000000.
Then we can move
on to the hard part.
scripts.translation:
[有機肥皂製造商 艾薇]
^4D4DFF10瓶牛奶^000000，
^4D4DFF100份綠色藥草^000000，
^4D4DFF50個傑勒比結晶^000000，
以及^4D4DFF5個空瓶^000000。
然後我們再處理比較困難的部分。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Oh, great! You brought
everything! Now... It's
time for you to do the,
um, hard part.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
哦，太棒了！
你都帶來了！
現在...該由你來完成那個，嗯，困難的部分了。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Please tell the
Silk Sand Camel farm
owner in town that I sent
you, and show him the
ingredients that you've
gathered for me so far.
scripts.translation:
[有機肥皂製造商 艾薇]
請去鎮上的絲沙駱駝農場找主人，告訴他是我派你來的，並給他看看你目前收集到的肥皂原料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait...
Why would I want
to see the guy that
takes care of Silk Sand
Camels? What does he
have to do with soap?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...我為什麼要去見那個照顧絲沙駱駝的人？
他和肥皂有什麼關係？

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Don't sweat it for now...
Just go visit Mr. Saraman,
the Camel Farm owner.
I can't wait for you that long,
so please come back here
as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[有機肥皂製造商 艾薇]
先別擔心那些...去拜訪駱駝農場主薩拉曼先生。我可等不了太久，請儘快回來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Saraman...?
Okay, so I need to visit
him if I really need you
to make the soap...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
薩拉曼先生...？
好吧，如果我真的需要你製作肥皂，我就得去拜訪他...

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Alright, first I want
you to bring me the basic
stuff. Bring these items
in the exact amounts I ask
for, alright? Ratios are pretty
important in making soap.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
好吧，首先我要你帶一些基礎材料。
請按照我要求的確切數量帶來，好嗎？
製作肥皂時，比例是非常重要的。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
^4D4DFF10 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF100 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Jellopies^000000, and
^4D4DFF5 Empty Bottles^000000.
Then we can move
on to the hard part.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
^4D4DFF10 牛奶^000000，^4D4DFF100 綠色藥草^000000，^4D4DFF50 傑勒比結晶^000000，以及^4D4DFF5 空瓶^000000。
然後我們就可以進入困難的部分了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to talk to
someone named Saraman
to get the soap ingredients...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我需要找個人叫薩拉曼，去獲取肥皂原料...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
I need to bring
Mr. Saruman all the
things he needs to
stimulate a camel's 
appetite. I need to get...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我想想...我得給薩拉曼先生帶齊刺激駱駝食慾的東西。我需要...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Monster's Feed^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Empty Bottle^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.

[{0}]
I have everything I need
to stimulate a camel's
appetite. Now I need to
feed the camel so that I can
get the soap ingredients and
5 lumps of camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已經備齊了刺激駱駝食慾的東西。
現在我需要喂駱駝，這樣才能拿到肥皂原料和5塊駱駝糞便。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Right now, my time
would be better spent
looking for the Silk Sand
Camel for the ingredients.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在，我的時間最好用來尋找絲沙駱駝，以獲取原料。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'd better find Mr. Saraman's
lost camel, feed it camel
appetite stimulants, and
then get the soap ingredient
and 5 lumps of camel dung
if I want to free Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得找到薩拉曼先生丟失的駱駝，餵它駱駝開胃劑，然後拿到肥皂原料和5塊駱駝糞便，這樣才能解救柯迪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I found the
camel. Now I need to get
all the soap ingredients.
The sooner I do that, the
sooner I can help Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我找到了駱駝。
現在我需要集齊所有的肥皂原料。
越快完成，我就能越快幫到柯迪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou already found the
camel, so you need to collect
the soap ingredients if you
want to free Curdie.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然你已經找到了駱駝，那麼如果你真想解開柯迪的腳鐐，就需要收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredients: 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料：5塊駱駝糞便。
我應該回去告訴薩拉曼他的駱駝在哪裡，然後再去找艾薇女士。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Hm, did Soony give you
any trouble? I'm guessing
that's why it's been taking
you so long to get all that
camel dung over here.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
嗯，蘇尼有沒有給你添麻煩？
我猜這就是你花了這麼長時間才把那些駱駝糞便弄過來的原因。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It was a pretty big
hassle... But hopefully,
this will all be worth it.
Anyway, take this camel
dung. I don't want to
handle it for much longer.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
確實挺麻煩的...但希望這一切都是值得的。
總之，拿著這些駱駝糞便吧。
我不想再碰它太久了。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Yes, I can understand that.
Even though it's in bottles,
it's pretty gross that these
bottles are still warm...
Anyway, we're good to go.
Let me make you some soap~
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
是的，我能理解。
雖然裝在瓶子裡，但這些瓶子還是溫的...
真噁心。總之，我們可以開始了。
讓我為你製作肥皂~

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
You spent a lot of
time and energy to get
these, so I won't charge
you for my service. Besides,
you brought enough materials
that I'll have some left over.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
你花了大量的時間和精力來收集這些，所以我不收你的服務費。
況且，你帶來的材料足夠多，我還會剩下一些。

scripts.text:
^3355FFMs. Ivory put on a pair
of long gloves, and mixed
the ingredients. She then
placed them in a clean bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾薇女士戴上了一雙長手套，混合了原料。
然後她將它們裝進了一個乾淨的瓶子裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
Here's your soap! After
you pour the soap into
something, don't forget
to put it into a larger bottle
after about twenty seconds.
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
這是你的肥皂！
當你把肥皂倒進什麼東西里後，別忘了在大約二十秒後把它放進一個更大的瓶子裡。

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
And um... Don't let
anyone else know what
I use to make this soap.
People won't buy it if they
knew they were washing their
faces with... You know...
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
還有...不要告訴任何人我用來製作這種肥皂的原料。
如果他們知道自己在用...你知道的...來洗臉，他們就不會買了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, I won't
tell anyone. Thanks
for making the soap!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心，我不會告訴任何人。
謝謝你製作的肥皂！

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow that you have the
Silk Sand Camel Soap.
you should bring it
to Mr. Lockenlock.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然你已經拿到了絲沙駱駝肥皂，你應該把它帶給洛肯洛克先生。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNow that you have the
Silk Sand Camel Soap.
you should bring it
to Mr. Lockenlock.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然你已經拿到了絲沙駱駝肥皂，你應該把它帶給洛肯洛克先生。^000000

scripts.text:
[Organic Soap Maker Ivory]
^333333*Phew!*^000000 It's been
a long day. I think
I'll close up shop now~
scripts.translation:
[有機皂師 艾薇]
^333333*呼!*^000000 真是漫長的一天。
我想我要打烊了~

scripts.text:
[Beautiful Lady]
Hm? Did you need
something? I'm still
setting up shop now
so I'm not really ready
to sell anything yet.
scripts.translation:
[美麗的女士]
嗯？
你需要什麼嗎？
我還在佈置店鋪，所以還沒準備好開始營業。

scripts.text:
[Saraman]
Zzzzz...
Zzz... Zzzzzz...
scripts.translation:
[薩拉曼]
呼嚕嚕...
呼... 呼嚕嚕...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me. Hello~
Ms. Ivory sent me
here with these soap
ingredients? She said
I had to come to you if
I wanted her to make it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下。
你好~艾薇女士派我來送這些肥皂原料。
她說如果我想讓她製作，就必須來找你。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Soap, eh? Oh, I see.
You must be here to get
some fresh camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
肥皂，是嗎？哦，我明白了。
你是來取一些新鮮的駱駝糞便的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wh-what?
My God!
A-are you sure?
Tell me you're joking!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什-什麼？
天哪！
你-你確定嗎？
告訴我你在開玩笑！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Sure as sin, and
honest to God.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
千真萬確，對天發誓。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Yeah, those ingredients
you brought me? They're for
making soap alright. ^FF0000That's
what we feed the camels^000000 so
that they make a whole lotta
dung. Dung to make soap.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
沒錯，你帶來的那些原料確實是肥皂材料。^FF0000那是我們餵給駱駝吃的^000000，這樣它們就會排出大量糞便。我們用糞便做肥皂。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh, don't worry. Camel
dung is sterile, completely
safe. In fact, it smells nice,
has medicinal properties, and
it's considered a delicacy
in certain countries.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
哦，別擔心。
駱駝糞便是無菌的，完全安全。
事實上，它聞起來很香，具有藥用價值，在某些國家甚至被視為美味佳餚。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Sadly, Silk Sand Camels
are almost extinct, so I only
have one on this farm. That's
why we have a special contract with Ms. Ivory to make her soap.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
不幸的是，絲沙駱駝幾乎滅絕了，所以我農場裡只有一隻。
這就是為什麼我們與艾薇女士有特別契約，讓她製作肥皂。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Say... I wasn't expecting
her to send a deliveryman
until tomorrow. Why are
you here so early anyway?
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
對了...我本以為她會明天才派人送貨。你怎麼這麼早就來了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, this is kind
of an emergency. You see,
I need the soap to make a
key mold because I lost--
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，這有點緊急。
你看，我需要肥皂來製作鑰匙模具，因為我丟了--

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Never mind, never mind.
I'm sorry I asked! So this
is a personal favor for you,
huh? Well, there's a bit of
a problem that we need to
solve first. Listen up...
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
算了，算了。
抱歉我問了！
所以這是你的私人委託，對吧？
嗯，有個小問題我們需要先解決。
聽好了...

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
We can only get camel
dung after a camel eats,
right? Well, my camel isn't
used to eating so late in the
day. Even if we put food in
front of her, she won't eat it.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
駱駝只有吃了東西才能產生糞便，對吧？
嗯，我的駱駝不習慣這麼晚進食。
即使我們把食物放在她面前，她也不會吃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Isn't there
something we can do?
I mean, I'm talking about
a life or death matter!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？
難道沒有什麼辦法嗎？
我是說，這可是生死攸關的大事！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
*Sigh* ...This isn't good... Okay then, let's do this.
Sometimes I make an appetite stimulant for the camel
when she's sick and wouldn't eat anything.
We can try feeding her the stimulant, and make it poop.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
*嘆氣*...這可不妙...好吧，我們這樣辦。駱駝生病不肯吃東西時，我會給它配開胃劑。我們試著喂她開胃劑，讓她排便。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Well, we can't forcefeed
her, but we can get her to
munch a bit on some appetite
stimulant. I usually use that
if she's sick, but if you say
that this is an emergency...
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
嗯，我們不能強行餵食，但我們可以讓她吃點開胃劑。
我通常在她生病時用這個，但如果你說這是緊急情況...

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Alright, I guess we
can try it. But I want you
to bring me the ingredients.
Get me... Let's see now...
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
好吧，我想我們可以試試。
但我要你帶原料來。
給我... 讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
^4D4DFF1 Unripe Apple^000000,
^4D4DFF5 Monster's Feed^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Empty Bottle^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Potion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
^4D4DFF1 青蘋果^000000，^4D4DFF5 魔物飼料^000000，^4D4DFF1 空瓶^000000，以及^4D4DFF1 黃色藥水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh good, you're back.
Did you bring everything?
Here, I need to mix it all
together first before you
can feed it to my camel.
Just a minute now...
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
太好了，你回來了。
東西都帶齊了嗎？
這裡，我得先把它們混合在一起，然後你才能餵給我的駱駝。
請稍等片刻...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSaraman mixed all
of the ingredients,
and gingerly poured
them into a bottle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF薩拉曼將所有材料混合，小心翼翼地倒進了瓶子裡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Alright, now bring
this to the camels over
there. Only my Silk Sand
Camel will know to eat it,
so she'll come after you.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
好了，現在把這個帶給那邊的駱駝。
只有我的絲沙駱駝會知道去吃它，所以她會跟著你走的。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Once she nibbles this
appetite stimulant, she'll
eat her feed like crazy.
Then the dung will flow
like a faucet. Come on,
why don't you give it a try?
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
一旦她嚐了這開胃劑，她就會瘋狂地吃飼料。
然後糞便就會像水龍頭一樣流出來。
來吧，何不試試看？

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh, right. You should
be able to get 5 lumps
of camel dung with those
ingredients. That's a good
amount to collect since that's
what Ms. Ivory usually orders.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
哦，對了。
用那些材料你應該能收集到5塊駱駝糞便。
這是一個不錯的數量，因為艾薇小姐通常訂購的就是這個量。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Saraman, none
of the camels will eat
this appetite stimulant...
Am I doing something wrong?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
薩拉曼先生，沒有一隻駱駝願意吃這開胃劑...我是不是做錯了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh, yes, well...
One of my workers
just came by, and told me
that my Silk Sand Camel
disappeared somewhere...
This is terrible news!
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
哦，是的，嗯...我的一個工人剛來過，告訴我我的絲沙駱駝不知跑到哪裡去了...這真是糟糕透頂的訊息！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
My precious Silk Sand
Camel... It's my biggest
business investment! I'm
ruined without it! Please...
I'll reward you if you can
find my camel for me!
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
我珍貴的絲沙駱駝...這是我最大的商業投資！
沒有它我就完了！
拜託...如果你能幫我找到駱駝，我會重重感謝你的！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Damn it! My stupid worker
forgot to tie her up, so
she ended up running away!
Ugh! Please help me find her!
Without her, you won't be able
to get your special camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
該死！
我那愚蠢的工人忘了把她拴住，結果她跑掉了！
唉！
請幫幫我找到她！
沒有她，你就拿不到那種特殊的駱駝糞便了。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Wait, don't panic...
It'll all be alright.
This camel moves very slowly
so she shouldn't be far from
here. Please find my camel
Soony as soon as you can!
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
等等，別慌...一切都會好起來的。這隻駱駝走得很慢，應該就在附近。請儘快幫我找到索妮！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Soony! Soony...!
Wh-where are you?!
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
索妮！索妮...
你...你在哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Please, help me find
my Soony, my Silk Sand
Camel. You won't be able to
make your soap without her!
And my business is really
dependent on my Soony!
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
拜託，幫我找到我的索妮，我的絲沙駱駝。
沒有她，你就做不出你想要的肥皂了！
而且我的生意真的很依賴我的索妮！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... I found the
camel. Now I need to get
all the soap ingredients.
The sooner I do that, the
sooner I can help Curdie.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...我找到了駱駝。
現在我需要集齊所有的肥皂原料。
越快完成，我就能越快幫到柯迪。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou already found the
camel, so you need to collect
the soap ingredients if you
want to free Curdie.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF既然你已經找到了駱駝，那麼如果你真想解開柯迪的腳鐐，就需要收集肥皂原料。^000000

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Oh, it's you!
Did you find my
Soony? Where is she?
What happened to her?
Oh God, I don't know what
I'll do without that camel!
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
哦，是你！
你找到我的索妮了嗎？
她在哪裡？
她怎麼了？
天哪，我不知道沒有那隻駱駝我該怎麼辦！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry, Mr. Saraman,
I found Soony at the outskirts
of town. She hurt her leg so
I think it'd be a good idea if
you sent some people to
help bring her back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心，薩拉曼先生，我在城鎮邊緣找到了索妮。她傷了腿，最好派些人去把她接回來。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Thank god! Thank you, thank you so much!
I'll send my workers over there immediately.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
謝天謝地！謝謝你，太感謝了！
我會立刻派我的工人過去。

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Thank goodness, you have
no idea how valuable that
camel is! I'll send some of
my men to bring her home
immediately! Thank you,
you just saved my business!
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
謝天謝地，你不知道那隻駱駝有多珍貴！
我會立刻派我的人把她帶回來！
謝謝你，你救了我的生意！

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Here, I want you to
have this. Consider it
a little thank you gift for
what you've done for me.
Good luck with getting
that soap you want made.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
拿著，我想讓你收下這個。
就當是對你為我所做之事的小小感謝禮物。
祝你在製作那種肥皂時好運。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's see...
Shouldn't I be going
to see Ms. Ivory now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
讓我想想...
我現在應該去找艾薇小姐嗎？

scripts.text:
[Camel Farm Owner Saraman]
Thank you for finding my
precious Silk Sand Camel
Soony. Come again sometime,
and maybe we can special my
special camel yogurt together.
scripts.translation:
[駱駝農場主 薩拉曼]
謝謝你找到了我珍貴的絲沙駱駝索妮。改天再來，也許我們可以一起嚐嚐我特製的駱駝酸奶。

scripts.text:
[Saraman]
Zzz... Zzz~
Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[薩拉曼]
呼... 呼~呼...

scripts.text:
^3355FFWatching this man
snore also makes you
want to take a snooze.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著這個男人打呼嚕，你也想打個盹了。^000000

nose away from it.^000000

scripts.translation:

*Neigh* ~
*Chew Chew*
scripts.translation:
[駱駝]
*嘶鳴* ~*嚼嚼 嚼嚼*

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis camel's leg is
wounded. Although it
seems hurt, its nostrils
flared as soon as it saw
the camel appetite stimulant,
and it smacked its lips.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這隻駱駝的腿受了傷。
雖然看起來很痛苦，但一看到駱駝開胃劑，它的鼻孔就張大了，還咂了咂嘴。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe camel started nibbling
the stimulant, but its eating
became quicker as it ate
more of the feed until it
was completely consumed.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF駱駝開始啃食開胃劑，隨著吃得越來越多，它的進食速度也越來越快，直到完全被吃光。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This must be the
Silk Sand Camel...
I guess all I need to
do is collect some of
that precious camel dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這應該就是絲沙駱駝了...看來我只需要收集一些珍貴的駱駝糞便。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe camel can smell
that you have food for
it, and started salivating.
You may as well just feed it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF駱駝聞到了你身上有它的食物，開始流口水了。
你不妨直接餵給它。^000000

scripts.text:
[Silk Sand Camel]
^333333*Chew Chew~*^000000
^333333*Smacks lips*^000000

^3355FFThe camel ate everything,
but it doesn't seem like
it'll go through any bowel
movements anytime soon.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF駱駝把東西全吃光了，但看起來短時間內它不會排便。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe camel grimaced
as if it were suffering
from a stomachache...
And... Out pops 2 Sweet
Potatoes. They're probably
safe to eat... Hopefully.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF駱駝痛苦地皺起臉，像是肚子疼...然後...吐出2個紅薯。應該...可以吃吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Silk Sand Camel]
^333333*Chew Chew~*^000000
^333333*Smacks lips*^000000

^3355FFThe camel grimaced
as if it were suffering
from a stomachache...
Huzzah! You got a lump
of steaming camel dung!
This is cause for celebration!^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF駱駝痛苦地皺起臉，像是肚子疼...萬歲！你得到了一坨熱騰騰的駱駝糞便！這值得慶祝！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
In my hands...
I am holding
5 lumps of camel dung.
This is my finest moment.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我手裡...有5坨駱駝糞便。這是我人生中最輝煌的時刻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now all I need is
just 4 more lumps
of this nasty old dung.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在我只需要再收集4坨這噁心的糞便了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Awesome! I got
2 glorious camel dung
lumps! Only 3 more to go!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
太棒了！
我得到了2坨光榮的駱駝糞便！
還差3坨！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes! Now I have
3 camel dung lumps.
Just 2 more... I'm more
than halfway done!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的！
現在我有了3坨駱駝糞便。
還差2坨... 我已經完成一半多了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
4 lumps of camel dung...
Heh heh! This is going
better than I thought!
Only 1 more to go!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
4坨駱駝糞便...
嘿嘿!！這比我想像的還要順利！
只差最後1坨了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Never, in all my years
of adventuring, saving the
oppressed, protecting the
innocent, did I dare dream
that I'd accomplish such
a magnificent feat.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在我多年的冒險生涯中，拯救受壓迫者，保護無辜者，我從未敢夢想過能完成如此偉大的壯舉。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am so happy--nay--
^4D4DFFproud^000000 that my strength, my
valor, and my determination
was up to this task. May the
annals of history never forget
this day! Long live {1}!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我太高興了——不——^4D4DFF自豪^000000，我的力量、勇氣和決心經受住了考驗。願史冊永遠銘記這一天！{1}萬歲！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's time for you to
return to Mr. Saraman.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF是時候回去找薩拉曼先生了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Silk Sand Camel]
^333333*Chew Chew~*^000000
^333333*Smacks lips*^000000

^3355FFThe camel grimaced
as if it were suffering
from a stomachache...
And... Out pops a Sweet
Potato. It's probably
safe to eat... Maybe.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF駱駝痛苦地皺起了眉頭，好像肚子疼一樣...然後...吐出了一顆紅薯。
應該...大概可以吃吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to feed this camel if
I ever want to get any dung
from it. Let's see, Mr. Saraman
mentioned that the items I got
for Ms. Ivory were actually
camel feed. I need to have...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我想從這隻駱駝身上弄到糞便，就得先餵它。
讓我想想，薩拉曼先生提到我給艾薇小姐的那些東西其實是駱駝飼料。
我需要準備...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did I run out of feed
already? Nuts, if I want
to feed this camel again,
then I need to bring it...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
飼料已經用完了嗎？
真是的，如果我還想再喂這隻駱駝，那就得再準備...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4D4DFF2 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF20 Green Herbs^000000,
^4D4DFF10 Jellopies^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Empty Bottles^000000.

[Silk Sand Camel]
*Chew Chew*
*Neigh Neigh*~
scripts.translation:
[絲沙駱駝]
*嚼嚼*
*嘶鳴 嘶鳴*~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I managed to get the soap
ingredients: 5 of those
camel dung lumps. I should
head back to Mr. Saraman to
tell him where his camel is,
and then go to Ms. Ivory.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我拿到了肥皂原料：5塊駱駝糞便。
我應該回去告訴薩拉曼他的駱駝在哪裡，然後再去找艾薇女士。

scripts.text:
[Silk Sand Camel]
*Neigh Neigh*~
scripts.translation:
[絲沙駱駝]
*嘶鳴 嘶鳴*

scripts.text: ^3355FFSilly camel.^000000

[Native Young Man]
My name is Toby.
I was born and raised here,
and no one knows more about
this town than me. Feel free
to ask if you need to find
your way around here.
scripts.translation:
[原住民青年]
我叫托比。
我出生並長大在這裡，沒有人比我更瞭解這個城鎮。
如果你需要找路，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, but do
you know where I can
find a locksmith?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下，你知道哪裡能找到鎖匠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Toby]
Of course, I do!
Mr. Lockenlock is a famous
locksmith, and he makes almost
all the keys and locks in Veins
and even in Rachel.
scripts.translation:
[托比]
當然知道！
洛肯洛克先生是著名的鎖匠，維因斯甚至拉赫的大部分鑰匙和鎖都是他做的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mr. Lockenlock, eh?
So where can I find him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
洛肯洛克先生，是嗎？
那我能在哪裡找到他呢？

scripts.text:
[Toby]
Oh, he's always sitting
somewhere in the market
street. He drinks a lot,
though, so he doesn't really
work when he's hung over.
scripts.translation:
[托比]
哦，他總坐在市場街的某處。不過他經常喝酒，宿醉時就沒法工作。

scripts.text:
[Toby]
Ah, but you know what'll
shock him back to sobriety?
A Yellow Potion! It never
fails with that guy!
scripts.translation:
[托比]
啊，不過有樣東西能讓他立刻清醒：黃色藥水！對那傢伙百試百靈！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
Thanks for
the advice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。
謝謝你的建議。

scripts.text:
[Toby]
You're so very
welcome! It's just...
After all these years...
I'm finally useful to someone!
scripts.translation:
[托比]
不客氣！只是...
這麼多年過去了...
我終於對別人有用處了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFFind Mr. Lockenlock
in the market street, and
bring him a Yellow Potion.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在市場街找到洛肯洛克先生，並給他帶一瓶黃色藥水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Toby]
After all these years...
I'm finally useful to someone!
scripts.translation:
[托比]
這麼多年過去了...
我終於對別人有用處了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFFind Mr. Lockenlock

scripts.translation: ^3355FF在市場街找到洛肯洛克先生，並給他帶一瓶黃色藥水。^000000

scripts.translation:

我出生並長大在這裡，沒有人比我更瞭解這個城鎮。
如果你需要找路，儘管問我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, thanks.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Native Young Man]
You don't...
^333333*Sob*^000000 You don't
need me at all?
scripts.translation:
[原住民青年]
你不需要我...^333333*嗚嗚*^000000你完全不需要我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
High Priest Vildt isn't
here right now. Please
come back later if you
wish to see him.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 卡魯姆]
大祭司 維爾德現在不在。
如果您想見他，請稍後再來。

scripts.text: Think of a Distraction
scripts.translation: 想個辦法分散他的注意力

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This guy's not going to
let me pass. Let's see...
Is there some way I could
get him to leave? What, or
even ^FF0000who^000000, could distract him?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這傢伙不讓我過去。讓我想想...有沒有辦法讓他離開？什麼，或者^FF0000誰^000000能分散他的注意力？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second...
Of course! I should
talk to him about...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等...
當然！我應該跟他聊聊...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait a second...
Of course! I should
talk to him about ^FF0000{1}^000000 !!

[{0}]
What the...?
Where did I think of that?
That doesn't make any sense...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這...？
我怎麼會想到這個？
這完全說不通...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right! I talked
to Lamir a while ago.
If she's right, then this
guy must be Karlum, the guy
who's totally in love with her.
Hmm... I know what I'll say...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沒錯！我剛才跟拉米爾聊過。如果她說的是真的，這傢伙一定是卡魯姆，那個完全迷戀她的人。嗯...我知道該說什麼了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Excuse me,
but are you Karlum?
I've got a message for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333*咳咳*^000000 打擾一下，你是卡魯姆嗎？
我有話要轉告你。

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
A message for me?
Is that why you're still
loitering around? Well,
spit it out. I can't waste
too much time on the job...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 卡魯姆]
給我留話？
這就是你一直在這裡閒逛的原因嗎？
快說吧。
我不能在崗位上浪費太多時間...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know ^3131FFLamir^000000, right?

[Guard Karlum]
Lamir? Oh... My.
Oh no! Did something
bad happen to her?
Quick, tell me!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 卡魯姆]
拉米爾？噢...
噢不！她出什麼事了嗎？
快告訴我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No, nothing like that.
She just told me that she
had something important to
tell you, and that you had to
come see her when you're free.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不，沒出什麼事。
她只是告訴我，她有一件重要的事要告訴你，讓你有空的時候務必去見她。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I tried to ask her
more, but she just kept
blushing and turning away.
Is there something going
on between you too?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想多問點，但她只是一直臉紅並轉過頭去。
你們之間是不是也有什麼？

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
...I don't believe it.
Finally. After all these
years. She feels the same
way I feel for her! My midnight
serenade a few days ago
must've touched her heart.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 卡魯姆]
...我不敢相信。終於，這麼多年了，她也喜歡我！幾天前我在午夜為她彈奏小夜曲，一定打動了她的心。

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
Screw this stupid job!
I've made my choice, and
I choose true love! I can't
keep Lamir waiting any longer!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 卡魯姆]
去死吧這破工作！
我已經做出了選擇，我選擇了真愛！
我不能讓拉米爾再等下去了！

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
Hey! Lamir told me that
she didn't want to see
me at all! What's your
game, huh? Do you think
I'm that easy to trick?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 卡魯姆]
嘿！
拉米爾告訴我她根本不想見我！
你在玩什麼把戲，嗯？
你以為我這麼好騙嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Is that what
happened? I could've
sworn th--Oooh. I get it now.
She must be playing hard to
get. That must mean that
she's reeeeally into you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？原來是這樣？我還以為...噢，我明白了。她一定是在欲擒故縱。這說明她真的很喜歡你。

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
Ah! That makes perfect
sense! No wonder she treated
me that way! Hahaha! I should
have figured it out sooner!
Well then, I should go see
her and play hard to get too!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 卡魯姆]
啊！
這就說得通了！
難怪她那樣對我！
哈哈哈!！
我早該想到的！
那麼，我也應該去見她，也欲擒故縱一下！

scripts.text:
[Guard Karlum]
High Priest Vildt isn't
here right now. Please
come back later if you
wish to see him.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 卡魯姆]
大祭司 維爾德現在不在。
如果您想見他，請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Guard Krodger]
High Priest Vildt isn't
here right now. Please
come back later if you
wish to see him.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 克羅傑]
大祭司 維爾德現在不在。
如果您想見他，請稍後再來。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a giant
vase full of beautiful
flowers that look freshly
picked from a garden.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個巨大的花瓶，裡面裝滿了美麗的鮮花，看起來像是剛從花園裡採摘的。^000000

scripts.text: Destroy Vase
scripts.translation: 打碎花瓶

scripts.text: Don't Destroy Vase
scripts.translation: 不打碎花瓶

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou grasp the flower
vase with both hands, and
then hurl it to the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你雙手握住花瓶，然後用力將其摔向地面。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guard Krodger]
Who's there?!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 克羅傑]
誰在那裡？！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A lot of loving care
was put into arranging
these flowers.. I can't
bear to disturb their beauty.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這些花顯然是經過精心佈置的...我無法忍受破壞它們的美麗。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAnd so you just
stood there, looking
a bit pitiable, but not
really all that pathetic.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF於是你就那樣站在那裡，看起來有些可憐，但也不算太狼狽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a giant
vase full of beautiful
flowers that look freshly
picked from a garden.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了一個巨大的花瓶，裡面裝滿了美麗的鮮花，看起來像是剛從花園裡採摘的。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lamir]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 High Priest Vildt
left over so much food after
eating. Didn't he learn to
finish all of his food?
scripts.translation:
[拉米爾]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000 大祭司 維爾德吃完後剩下了那麼多食物。
難道他沒學會把食物吃光嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lamir]
You know, my mother used
to threaten that she'd force
me to marry Karlum if I didn't
finish all my food when I was
a kid. I learned never to
leave any leftovers that way~
scripts.translation:
[拉米爾]
你知道嗎，我母親以前總是威脅我，如果我不把食物吃光，就逼我嫁給卡魯姆。
從那以後我就學會了絕不剩飯~

scripts.text: Who's Karlum?
scripts.translation: 卡魯姆是誰？

scripts.text:
[Lamir]
Karlum? Oh, he's been
chasing me ever since we
were kids, declaring his
love and all that. Even
after we grew up, he's still
stubborn about that point.
scripts.translation:
[拉米爾]
卡魯姆？
哦，他從我們小時候起就一直在追我，還總是向我表白什麼的。
即使我們長大了，他在這點上依然很固執。

scripts.text:
[Lamir]
Ugh! Even today, he
still gets on my nerves!
I mean, it's great that he's
a guard at High Priest Vildt's
office, but come on! Why can't
he bother another girl?
scripts.translation:
[拉米爾]
真是的！
直到今天，他依然讓我很煩！
雖然他是大祭司 維爾德辦公室的衛兵，這很好，但拜託！
他為什麼不能去糾纏別的女孩呢？

scripts.text:
[Guard Krodger]
What's with this vase?
They always send me out
here to clean up this mess!
I mean, it happens so often,
I don't think it's accidental.
You think it's vandals?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 克羅傑]
這個花瓶是怎麼回事？
他們總是派我出來清理這種爛攤子！
而且發生得太頻繁了，我覺得這不是意外。
你覺得是有人故意破壞嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are some neatly
printed and organized
documents inside
these drawers.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這些抽屜裡整齊地擺放著整理好的檔案。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second!
Right now, you're carrying
too many things with you.
Please come back after
using the Kafra Service
to store some of your items.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在攜帶的物品太多了。
請先使用卡普拉服務將部分物品存入倉庫，然後再回來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a thick pile
of reports submitted
to the high priest
inside this drawer.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在這個抽屜裡發現了一疊厚厚的、提交給大祭司的報告。^000000

scripts.text: Check the Reports
scripts.translation: 檢視報告

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, it might not to
the most moral thing,
but I get the feeling
that I should at least
check some of these out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，這可能不太道德，但我覺得至少應該檢查一下這些檔案。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou started shuffling
through the documents,
glancing at a few that
catch your interest.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你開始翻閱檔案，瞥了一眼那些引起你興趣的檔案。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ooh...
This might be
what I'm looking for.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢...
這可能就是我在找的東西。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the thick report
labeled ''Veins Geological
Research Institute'' on
the cover, and then you
close the drawer.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你拿起那本封面寫著“維因斯地質研究所”的厚報告，然後關上抽屜。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Forget it.
I didn't get permission
to look through these files.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
算了。
我沒有許可權檢視這些檔案。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh! Here's another
copy of that report
I wanted! Pretty lucky~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
噢！
這裡還有另一份我想要的那份報告！
運氣真好~

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a thick pile
of reports submitted

scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在這個抽屜裡發現了一疊厚厚的、提交給大祭司的報告。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a thick pile
of reports submitted
to the high priest
inside this drawer.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你在這個抽屜裡發現了一疊厚厚的、提交給大祭司的報告。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a statue of Freya,
a goddess revered for her
clemency and wisdom.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這是一尊芙蕾雅女神的雕像，她以仁慈和智慧受到人們的崇敬。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wait, I can use this
ladder to sneak out of
here! I snuck inside so
I'd get caught if I just
passed the guards...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等等，我可以用這個梯子偷偷溜出去！
既然我是偷偷進來的，要是直接經過衛兵那裡肯定會被抓住...

scripts.text: Climb Ladder
scripts.translation: 爬上梯子

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou climbed the
ladder over the
wall and snuck out.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你爬上梯子翻過牆，偷偷溜了出去。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decided not to climb
up the ladder for now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你決定暫時不爬梯子。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis house looks like
it's been abandoned for
a while: the floor is thickly
covered with dust and many
pieces of discarded paper.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這棟房子看起來已經廢棄很久了：地板上積滿了厚厚的灰塵，還有許多被丟棄的紙張。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne particular piece
of paper catches your
attention. You pick it
up and give it a read.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一張紙引起了你的注意。你撿起來讀了讀。^000000

scripts.text:
[Paper]
''^333333The regularly scheduled
geological survey had been
postponed for over a week.
Please submit your report
to us as soon as possible.^000000''
scripts.translation:
[紙張]
“^333333定期地質勘探已推遲超過一週。請儘快向我們提交報告。^000000”

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Although the sender's
name isn't on this letter,

director, researcher, CEO,

該死！

form to the geology camp

scripts.text:

to take these lovely ladies
on as my students as well~

entreat them to a lecture.
scripts.translation:

啊，我還決定收這些可愛的女士們為我的學生~我應該留在這裡給她們上一課。

teach us geology?
scripts.translation:
[女士們]
哦~！
你真的要教我們地質學嗎？

ask you about the volcano's
temperature when you submit
the report at the geological
camp, make something up.

scripts.translation:

對了！提交報告給地質營地時，如果他們問火山溫度，就隨便編一個。務必說得嚴重些！

scripts.text:
[Geologist Gio]
Words like ''explosion,''
''disaster,'' and ''collatoral
damage'' would be perfect.
Just do your part, and I'll
take care of the rest. Okay~
Come back soon, my pupil!

a decent living. Hell, I was
lucky enough to get that

to fire me ever since they
realized the volcano became
dormant. But... They can't
fire me if there's proof that
it might go off anytime!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

Then, when they're all
panicked, I calmly and
suavely offer a solution
that looks like it works.
Of course, there's never
a problem to begin with...
scripts.translation:

check out my bookshelf?

of nifty little goodies.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

first thing that pops out
of that box. I wonder if the
goddess will grace you
with good fortune. You
might get something good~
scripts.translation:

你可以拿走從那個盒子裡掉出來的第一樣東西。

說不定能拿到好東西哦~

scripts.text:

payment for a job
well done. Good work!
I expected nothing less
from my star pupil!

not the one that stamps

south of the train station.

哦，我明白了。不過蓋報告章的人不是我。進去找薩赫迪幫忙。他在火車站南邊的飛空艇上。

好吧，好吧，我能理解。

scripts.text:

Institute. Would you please

[{0}]

麻煩您在這份溫度報告上蓋個章好嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Um, Gio is sick right
now, so that's why he
had me fill out this report
form and submit it for him.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，吉奧現在生病了，所以他讓我填寫這份報告並替他提交。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Ah, so that's why his
report's late this time.
I'm sorry to hear that.
And here I thought he was
just wasting his time on
women and alcohol...
scripts.translation:
[薩赫迪]
啊，原來他這次報告遲交是因為這個。真遺憾。我還以為他只是把時間浪費在女人和酒上...

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[薩赫迪]
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Oh God! Why is the
temperature so high?!
We've had a few reports
like this in the past, but...
Is this... How bad is this?
scripts.translation:
[薩赫迪]
天哪！為什麼溫度這麼高？！
過去我們也收到過類似的報告，但是...
這是...情況有多嚴重？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh... Oh, no!
Yikes! I guess if it's
higher than normal...
It might be bad?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦...哦，不！
天哪！我想如果比正常值高...
可能會很糟糕？

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
What should I do?
Should I activate
the alarm? I don't...
I don't wanna die!
scripts.translation:
[薩赫迪]
我該怎麼辦？
應該啟動警報嗎？
我...我不想死！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You might want to calm
down first. I'll take a look
around the camp, so please
don't say anything that will
make anyone else panic for now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你最好先冷靜下來。我會在營地四周檢視，請暫時別說會讓其他人恐慌的話。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Okay...
Please go ahead, and
see if this camp will be
safe from any disaster.
scripts.translation:
[薩赫迪]
好的...請去吧，看看這個營地是否能安全地避開任何災難。

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
So, are we in any
danger? Does it look
like this volcano will
erupt anytime soon?
scripts.translation:
[薩赫迪]
那麼，我們有危險嗎？
看起來這座火山會隨時噴發嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I'm not finished
investigating yet. Would
you please wait a bit longer?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，我還沒調查完。
請再稍等一下好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sahedi]
Sure, sure. Just make
sure that you do a real
thorough check of everything
in the volcano for me, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[薩赫迪]

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

你是認真的嗎？
托爾火山要噴發？！

這會是一場災難，就像過去發生過的那樣！

a lot of collateral damage.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

How much time do we
have to evacuate?
scripts.translation:

the next thirty days.

[{0}]

this to the high priest
immediately! Aitra!
scripts.translation:

什麼？！

艾特拉！

Yes, sir!

Bring this message to
the high priest as soon

forget to pack all your
things before you leave.
scripts.translation:

這是緊急情況。

 ...Yes, sir.

report to your director, Gio?

advice for what we can
do about this disaster...
scripts.translation:

哦，這真是噩夢...請把報告帶給你們的總監吉奧好嗎？希望他能給我們一些應對這場災難的建議...

啊，我太忙了！

我是上校維托，負責管理托爾火山這裡的阿魯納佩茨營地。

be worthy of serving the

scripts.translation:

哼！

Who do we live for?
scripts.translation:

我們為誰而戰？

to recover the pieces of

in the war among gods,
humans, and demons.

gods, tried to help her, but
even his power wasn't enough.

scripts.text:

obtain Ymir's Heart, as
it would fully recover her
powers. That is why we are
preparing for war: we must
obtain Ymir's Heart for Freya!
scripts.translation:

^FF0000我將奉獻我的一生^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I shall devote my
entire life to the
full recovery of
Goddess Freya.^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我將奉獻我的一生，
使女神芙蕾雅完全恢復神力。^000000

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Wrong! Try again!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
錯了！再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
^FF0000Down with the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!^000000
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
^FF0000打倒盧恩·米德加茲王國！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Down with the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打倒盧恩·米德加茲王國！^000000

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Wrong! Try again!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
錯了！再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Good. Now you know the
kind of attitude that you
must have as a holy warrior
in Freya's service. That
is all for the first exercise,
but there's one more left.
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
很好。
現在你知道作為侍奉芙蕾雅的女神戰士，必須具備怎樣的態度了。
第一項訓練到此結束，但還有一項。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Before we actually do
the 2nd training exercise,
I have a duty to assign to
you. Find the huge pipe zone
to the north of this building
and find any broken machines.
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
在進行第二項訓練前，我要交給你一項任務。去這棟建築北邊的大型管道區，找出損壞的機器。

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Inspect the machines
in the pipe zone to the
north of this building.
Don't dawdle: move out!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
檢查這棟建築北邊管道區的機器。別磨蹭，出發！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Good work. Remember
that your first priority is to
check the control panel.
It needs to be regularly
inspected since it controls
the camp's energy resources.
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
幹得好。
記住，你的首要任務是檢查控制面板。
因為它控制著營地的能量資源，所以需要定期檢修。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, sir!

[Colonel Vito]
Now it's time for the
second training exercise
which will strengthen your
body. See the dummy in
front of you? Practice by
chopping it 10 times. Go!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
現在是第二項訓練的時間，這將增強你的體魄。
看到前面的假人了嗎？
練習砍它10次。
開始！

scripts.text: Yes, sir!
scripts.translation: 是的，長官！

scripts.text: What do you mean by chop?
scripts.translation: 砍是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Focus your energy in
your yell when you strike!
Chop! 10 Times! Do it!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
出招時集中你的能量大喊！
砍！10次！做！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Chop...? It's a hand chop.
You strike the enemy with
the bottom of your hand
like a knife blade. How
did you join the army
without knowing that?
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
手刀...？用手掌底部像刀刃一樣擊打敵人。你連這個都不知道，是怎麼加入軍隊的？

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Focus your energy in
your yell when you strike!
Chop! 10 Times! Do it!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
出招時集中你的能量大喊！
砍！10次！做！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
The more you train,
the stronger you become.
As you grow stronger, so
does Freya's holy troops.
Train everyday, and don't
you ever slack off!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
訓練越多，你就越強。
隨著你變強，芙蕾雅的神聖軍隊也會變強。
每天訓練，絕對不要偷懶！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, sir!

[Colonel Vito]
That is all for your
training. If you have
any questions about camp
life, go ask Sahedi right
outside this building.
You are dismissed.
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
你的訓練到此結束。
如果有關於營地生活的問題，去問這棟建築外面的薩赫迪。
你被解散了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
(^333333Well... I think
I will go back to
Sahedi. Hopefully,
he'll think of me as
a geological researcher
instead of as a soldier.^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
(^333333嗯...我想我還是回去找薩赫迪吧。
希望他會把我看作地質研究員，而不是士兵。^000000)

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
We must be ever
vigilant in our training.
You can never know when
Freya will call on us to fight!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
我們必須時刻保持警惕。
你永遠不知道芙蕾雅何時會召喚我們戰鬥！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere's a stream of
magma running down
through a path under
the barbed wires.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF有一道岩漿流沿著鐵絲網下的路徑流淌。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can hear the faint
sound of hammering, as if
iron was being manufactured
from deep underground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你能聽到微弱的錘擊聲，彷彿是從地下深處鍛造鐵器一般。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPeople are carrying
many heavy wooden boxes
imprinted with the stamp
of the Schwarzwald Republic.
These must contain military
supplies for the camp.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF人們搬運著許多印有施瓦爾茲巴爾德共和國印章的重木箱。
這些裡面裝的應該是營地的軍用物資。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should go back
to Sahedi now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我現在應該回去找薩赫迪了。

scripts.text:
[Thor Volcano Camp Soldier]
Freya, I'm so exhausted!
I'm starving to death too!
When will we get more rations?
scripts.translation:
[托爾火山營地士兵]
芙蕾雅，我累死了！
我快餓死了！
什麼時候能補充口糧啊？

scripts.text:
[Thor Volcano Camp Soldier]
I hear we'll be eating
chicken salad, fried chicken,
and Kunlun style chicken for
dinner tonight! I wonder who
was rich enough to donate
so much chicken to us?
scripts.translation:
[托爾火山營地士兵]
我聽說今晚的晚餐是雞肉沙拉、炸雞和崑崙風味雞肉！
真不知道是誰這麼大方，給我們捐了這麼多雞肉？

scripts.text:
[Thor Volcano Camp Soldier]
Heheh...
I can't wait for dinner!
scripts.translation:
[托爾火山營地士兵]
嘿嘿...
我迫不及待想開飯了！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis control panel
controls the main power
resources for the Thor
Volcano camp, helping it
run its operations smoothly
under the ground.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這個控制面板管理著托爾火山營地的主要能源，讓營地在地下也能正常運作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
All these pipes with molten
rock flowing through them...
I guess their heat is what
powers this camp. That's
actually a smart idea~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這些管道里流淌著熔岩...我想營地就是靠它們產生的熱量運作的。其實這個主意挺聰明的~

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe control panel emits
faint mechanical noises
and seems to be running
pretty smoothly. Everything
looks to be in working order.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF控制面板發出微弱的機械聲，執行得相當平穩。
一切看起來都運轉正常。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No problems here.
I guess I can go
back to that colonel.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡沒有問題。
我想我可以回去找那位上校了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a training dummy
that looks like it can
take a beating. Its chest
is marked with the emblem
of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這是一個看起來很耐打的訓練假人。
它的胸口印著盧恩·米德加茲王國的徽章。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wow...
They really hate the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom...
(^333333Technically, I shouldn't
be doing this. Isn't this
considered treason?^000000)
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇...他們真的很討厭盧恩·米德加茲王國...(^333333嚴格來說，我不該做這種事。
這算不算叛國？^000000)

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
I can't hear you,
soldier! Make your
voice loud and clear!
Now... Execute attack!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
我聽不見，士兵！
大聲點！
現在...執行攻擊！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, sir!

[{0}]
Three!!

[{0}]
Four!

[{0}]
Seven!!

[{0}]
Eight!!

[{0}]
Nine!

[Colonel Vito]
Soldier...
How many times
did I order you to
chop the dummy?
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
士兵...我命令你砍木樁多少次了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
10 times, sir!

[Colonel Vito]
And how many times
did you actually
chop the dummy?
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
那你實際砍了多少次？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
11 times, sir!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
十一次，長官！

scripts.text:
[Colonel Vito]
Unacceptable!
Listen to your orders
this time, and do it
again properly!
scripts.translation:
[上校 維托]
不可原諒！
這次給我聽清楚命令，好好再做一次！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not
do anything too
conspicuous in
front of him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在他面前最好別做什麼太顯眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:

scripts.translation: ^3355FF在他面前最好別做什麼太顯眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not
do anything too
conspicuous in
front of him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在他面前最好別做什麼太顯眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Oh Freya...
Bless this Old Blue Box
so that I don't get anything
lame again. I am so tired
of getting arrows from these...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
哦，芙蕾雅...請祝福這個藍色魔法箱，別再讓我抽到垃圾了。我受夠了從這些箱子裡抽出箭矢...

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Ah, time to
go to work.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
啊，該去工作了。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
What th-?!
Something smells
like sweaty socks that
haven't been washed!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
什-什麼？！
什麼東西聞起來像沒洗過的臭襪子！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Yo-ho! Yo-ho!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
喲呵！喲呵！

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
I guess I need to go
on Guardian polishing
duty. Those things are
so huge, and I gotta
clean up about twenty...
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
看來我得去執行守護者的拋光工作。那些傢伙個頭真大，我得清理二十個左右...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are many guardians
here in different stages
of disassembly. It looks
like they're all in the
middle of being repaired.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡有不同拆解階段的守衛。
看起來它們都在維修中。^000000

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Aren't you the one from
the geological research
center? There's nothing
for you here, we're just
performing maintenance
on these guardians.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
你難道不是地質研究中心的人嗎？
這裡沒什麼給你的，我們只是在維護這些守衛。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Why am I always
stationed here?!
No one ever comes
here! Nobody!
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
為什麼我總是被派到這裡？！
從來沒人來這裡！
一個都沒有！

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere is an old man
in high priest robes
in front of you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你面前有一位穿著大祭司長袍的老人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou'd better not
do anything too
conspicuous in
front of him.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF在他面前最好別做什麼太顯眼的事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Guard]
What now?
Can't you see I'm busy?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
怎麼了？
沒看到我正忙著嗎？

scripts.text: Let me go out.
scripts.translation: 讓我出去

scripts.text: I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 對不起

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Hurry up, and get out!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
快點，滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
If you're sorry,
stop bugging me!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
如果你感到抱歉，就別再煩我了！

scripts.text:
[House Owner]
Wh-who the hell
are you? Honey!
There's this...
person in our home!
scripts.translation:
[屋主]
你...你他媽是誰？親愛的！家裡有...有個人！

scripts.text:
^3355FFHubbie never came.
Nobody messes with
{0}. Nobody.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF老公一直沒回來。沒人能招惹{0}。沒人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Welcome to our tavern.
Please, have a seat.
Let me bring you a
glass of ice water first.
scripts.translation:
[調酒師]
歡迎光臨酒館。
請坐。
我先給您倒杯冰水。

scripts.text:
[Female Customer]
Bartender, aren't any of
your regulars nice young
men? You know, I've been
pretty lonely lately...
scripts.translation:
[女顧客]
調酒師，你的常客裡有沒有什麼帥哥？
你知道的，我最近挺寂寞的...

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Haha, well,
I'm not so sure..
scripts.translation:
[調酒師]
哈哈，這個嘛，我不太確定...

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
How about... me?
scripts.translation:
[調酒師]
要不...算我一個？

scripts.text:
[Female Customer]
Hmpf...
scripts.translation:
[女顧客]
哼...

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Oh, come on!
I was kidding~
scripts.translation:
[調酒師]
哎呀！
我開玩笑的~

scripts.text:
[Bartender]
Haha, well,
I'm not so sure..
What about this nice
young adventurer here?
scripts.translation:
[調酒師]
哈哈，這個嘛，我不太確定...這位帥氣的年輕冒險者怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Meee?

[Female Customer]
Mmm...
Not my style.
scripts.translation:
[女顧客]
嗯...
不是我的菜。

scripts.text:
[Male Customer]
How can that ugly old
man have girls hanging
off his arms when I just
got dumped by my girlfriend
and ditched by all my friends?!
scripts.translation:
[男顧客]
那個醜陋的老頭怎麼能讓女孩們圍著他轉，而我剛被女朋友甩了，還被所有朋友拋棄了？！

scripts.text:
[Male Customer]
Oh, alcohol...
Right now, you're
my only friend in
all the world...
A toast... To drinking!
scripts.translation:
[男顧客]
哦，酒精...
現在，你是我在這世上唯一的朋友...
乾杯...為了喝酒！
